verses.textEnNlt: "The king should know that we went to the construction site of the Temple of the great God in the province of Judah. It is being rebuilt with specially prepared stones, and timber is being laid in its walls. The work is going forward with great energy and success.
verses.textEnNasb: May it be known to the king that we have gone to the province of Judah, to the house of the great God which is being built with large stones, and beams are being laid in the walls; and this work is being performed with great care and is succeeding in their hands.
verses.textEn: The king should know that we went to the district of Judah, to the temple of the great God. The people are building it with large stones and placing the timbers in the walls. The work is being carried on with diligence and is making rapid progress under their direction.

verses.textZh: 于是，我们就这样问那些长老，对他们说：‘谁下令叫你们重建这殿，完成这工程呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，我们就这样问那些长老，对他们说：‘谁下令叫你们重建这殿，完成这工程呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 我们就问那些长老说：『谁降旨让你们建造这殿，修成这墙呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: We questioned the elders and asked them, "Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and to finish it?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then we asked those elders and spoke to them thus: ‘Who gave you a decree to build this house and to finish this structure?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then we asked those elders, and spoke thus to them: "Who commanded you to build this temple and to finish these walls?"
verses.textEnNlt: "We asked the leaders, ‘Who gave you permission to rebuild this Temple and restore this structure?’
verses.textEnNasb: Then we asked those elders and said to them as follows: ‘Who issued you a decree to rebuild this temple and to finish this structure?’
verses.textEn: We questioned the elders and asked them, "Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and to finish it?"

verses.textZh: 为了奏知大王，就问他们的名字，记录他们首领的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了奏知大王，就问他们的名字，记录他们首领的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 又问他们的名字，要记录他们首领的名字，奏告于王。
verses.textEnNiv: We also asked them their names, so that we could write down the names of their leaders for your information.
verses.textEnEsv: We also asked them their names, for your information, that we might write down the names of their leaders.
verses.textEnNkjv: We also asked them their names to inform you, that we might write the names of the men who were chief among them.
verses.textEnNlt: And we demanded their names so that we could tell you who the leaders were.
verses.textEnNasb: We also asked them their names so as to inform you, in order that we might write down the names of the men who were in charge.
verses.textEn: We also asked them their names, so that we could write down the names of their leaders for your information.

verses.textZh: 他们这样答复我们，说：‘我们是天地之神的仆人，正在重建这多年以前已经建好的殿，就是一位以色列伟大的君王所建成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们这样答复我们，说：‘我们是天地之神的仆人，正在重建这多年以前已经建好的殿，就是一位以色列伟大的君王所建成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回答说：『我们是天地之神的仆人，重建前多年所建造的殿，就是以色列的一位大君王建造修成的。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the answer they gave us: "We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago, one that a great king of Israel built and finished.
verses.textEnEsv: And this was their reply to us: ‘We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the house that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished.
verses.textEnNkjv: And thus they returned us an answer, saying: "We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and completed.
verses.textEnNlt: "This was their answer: ‘We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the Temple that was built here many years ago by a great king of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So they answered us as follows, saying, ‘We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and are rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished.
verses.textEn: This is the answer they gave us: "We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago, one that a great king of Israel built and finished.

verses.textZh: 但因为我们的祖先激怒了天上的神，神就把他们交在迦勒底人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中；尼布甲尼撒就拆毁这殿，把人民掳到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但因为我们的祖先激怒了天上的神，神就把他们交在迦勒底人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中；尼布甲尼撒就拆毁这殿，把人民掳到巴比伦去。
verses.textZhCuv: 只因我们列祖惹天上的神发怒，神把他们交在迦勒底人巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手中，他就拆毁这殿，又将百姓掳到巴比伦。
verses.textEnNiv: But because our ancestors angered the God of heaven, he gave them into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar the Chaldean, king of Babylon, who destroyed this temple and deported the people to Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: But because our fathers had angered the God of heaven, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house and carried away the people to Babylonia.
verses.textEnNkjv: But because our fathers provoked the God of heaven to wrath, He gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this temple and carried the people away to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: But because our ancestors angered the God of heaven, he abandoned them to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, who destroyed this Temple and exiled the people to Babylonia.
verses.textEnNasb: But because our fathers provoked the God of heaven to wrath, He handed them over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this temple and deported the people to Babylon.
verses.textEn: But because our ancestors angered the God of heaven, he gave them into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar the Chaldean, king of Babylon, who destroyed this temple and deported the people to Babylon.

verses.textZh: 然而在巴比伦王古列元年，古列王下令重建这神的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而在巴比伦王古列元年，古列王下令重建这神的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而巴比伦王塞鲁士元年，他降旨允准建造神的这殿。
verses.textEnNiv: "However, in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, King Cyrus issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.
verses.textEnEsv: However, in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus the king made a decree that this house of God should be rebuilt.
verses.textEnNkjv: However, in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, King Cyrus issued a decree to build this house of God.
verses.textEnNlt: However, King Cyrus of Babylon, during the first year of his reign, issued a decree that the Temple of God should be rebuilt.
verses.textEnNasb: However, in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, King Cyrus issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.
verses.textEn: "However, in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, King Cyrus issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.

verses.textZh: 至于从前尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷的殿里掠夺，带到巴比伦庙里的神殿中的金银器皿，古列王也从巴比伦的庙中拿出来，把它们交给一位名叫设巴萨的人，委任他为总督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于从前尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷的殿里掠夺，带到巴比伦庙里的神殿中的金银器皿，古列王也从巴比伦的庙中拿出来，把它们交给一位名叫设巴萨的人，委任他为总督。
verses.textZhCuv: 神殿中的金、银器皿，就是尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷的殿中掠去带到巴比伦庙里的，塞鲁士王从巴比伦庙里取出来，交给派为省长的，名叫设巴萨，
verses.textEnNiv: He even removed from the temple of Babylon the gold and silver articles of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to the temple in Babylon. Then King Cyrus gave them to a man named Sheshbazzar, whom he had appointed governor,
verses.textEnEsv: And the gold and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple that was in Jerusalem and brought into the temple of Babylon, these Cyrus the king took out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to one whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, the gold and silver articles of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple that was in Jerusalem and carried into the temple of Babylon—those King Cyrus took from the temple of Babylon, and they were given to one named Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor.
verses.textEnNlt: King Cyrus returned the gold and silver cups that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the Temple of God in Jerusalem and had placed in the temple of Babylon. These cups were taken from that temple and presented to a man named Sheshbazzar, whom King Cyrus appointed as governor of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Also the gold and silver utensils of the house of God which Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple in Jerusalem and brought them to the temple of Babylon, King Cyrus took them from the temple of Babylon and they were given to one whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had appointed governor.
verses.textEn: He even removed from the temple of Babylon the gold and silver articles of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to the temple in Babylon. Then King Cyrus gave them to a man named Sheshbazzar, whom he had appointed governor,

verses.textZh: 又吩咐他说：把这些器皿带去，存放在耶路撒冷的殿中；使神的殿在原来的地方重建起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又吩咐他说：把这些器皿带去，存放在耶路撒冷的殿中；使神的殿在原来的地方重建起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说可以将这些器皿带去，放在耶路撒冷的殿中，在原处建造神的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: and he told him, ‘Take these articles and go and deposit them in the temple in Jerusalem. And rebuild the house of God on its site.’
verses.textEnEsv: and he said to him, "Take these vessels, go and put them in the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be rebuilt on its site."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to him, ‘Take these articles; go, carry them to the temple site that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be rebuilt on its former site.’
verses.textEnNlt: The king instructed him to return the cups to their place in Jerusalem and to rebuild the Temple of God there on its original site.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to him, "Take these utensils, go and deposit them in the temple in Jerusalem, and have the house of God rebuilt in its place."
verses.textEn: and he told him, ‘Take these articles and go and deposit them in the temple in Jerusalem. And rebuild the house of God on its site.’

verses.textZh: 于是，这设巴萨回来，奠立了在耶路撒冷神的殿的根基；从那时起，到现在一直在建造，还没有完成。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，这设巴萨回来，奠立了在耶路撒冷神的殿的根基；从那时起，到现在一直在建造，还没有完成。’
verses.textZhCuv: 于是这设巴萨来建立耶路撒冷神殿的根基。这殿从那时直到如今尚未造成。』
verses.textEnNiv: "So this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of the house of God in Jerusalem. From that day to the present it has been under construction but is not yet finished."
verses.textEnEsv: Then this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of the house of God that is in Jerusalem, and from that time until now it has been in building, and it is not yet finished.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the same Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem; but from that time even until now it has been under construction, and it is not finished."
verses.textEnNlt: So this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of the Temple of God in Jerusalem. The people have been working on it ever since, though it is not yet completed.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then that Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of the house of God in Jerusalem; and from then until now it has been under construction and it is not yet completed.’
verses.textEn: "So this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of the house of God in Jerusalem. From that day to the present it has been under construction but is not yet finished."

verses.textZh: 现在王若是以为好，就请查考王在巴比伦的库房，看看那里有没有古列王下令，重建这在耶路撒冷神的殿的谕旨，并请指示我们王对这事的旨意。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在王若是以为好，就请查考王在巴比伦的库房，看看那里有没有古列王下令，重建这在耶路撒冷神的殿的谕旨，并请指示我们王对这事的旨意。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在王若以为美，请察巴比伦王的府库，看塞鲁士王降旨允准在耶路撒冷建造神的殿没有，王的心意如何？请降旨晓谕我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now if it pleases the king, let a search be made in the royal archives of Babylon to see if King Cyrus did in fact issue a decree to rebuild this house of God in Jerusalem. Then let the king send us his decision in this matter.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, if it seems good to the king, let search be made in the royal archives there in Babylon, to see whether a decree was issued by Cyrus the king for the rebuilding of this house of God in Jerusalem. And let the king send us his pleasure in this matter."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, if itseems good to the king, let a search be made in the king’s treasure house, which is there in Babylon, whether it is so that a decree was issued by King Cyrus to build this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send us his pleasure concerning this matter.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, if it pleases the king, we request that a search be made in the royal archives of Babylon to discover whether King Cyrus ever issued a decree to rebuild God’s Temple in Jerusalem. And then let the king send us his decision in this matter."
verses.textEnNasb: And now, if it pleases the king, let a search be conducted in the king’s treasure house, which is there in Babylon, as to whether a decree was issued by King Cyrus to rebuild this house of God in Jerusalem; and let the king send to us his decision concerning this matter."
verses.textEn: Now if it pleases the king, let a search be made in the royal archives of Babylon to see if King Cyrus did in fact issue a decree to rebuild this house of God in Jerusalem. Then let the king send us his decision in this matter.

verses.textZh: 于是，大利乌王下令考查在巴比伦库房的档案，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，大利乌王下令考查在巴比伦库房的档案，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是大流士王降旨，要寻察典籍库内，就是在巴比伦藏宝物之处；
verses.textEnNiv: King Darius then issued an order, and they searched in the archives stored in the treasury at Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in Babylonia, in the house of the archives where the documents were stored.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Darius issued a decree, and a search was made in the archives, where the treasures were stored in Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: So King Darius issued orders that a search be made in the Babylonian archives, which were stored in the treasury.
verses.textEnNasb: Then King Darius issued a decree, and a search was conducted in the archives, where the treasures were stored in Babylon.
verses.textEn: King Darius then issued an order, and they searched in the archives stored in the treasury at Babylon.

verses.textZh: 在玛代省的亚马他宫中，发现了一卷书卷。其中写着这样的一段记录：
verses.textZhCnvs: 在玛代省的亚马他宫中，发现了一卷书卷。其中写着这样的一段记录：
verses.textZhCuv: 在米底亚省亚马他城的宫内寻得一卷，其中记着说：
verses.textEnNiv: A scroll was found in the citadel of Ecbatana in the province of Media, and this was written on it: Memorandum:
verses.textEnEsv: And in Ecbatana, the citadel that is in the province of Media, a scroll was found on which this was written: "A record.
verses.textEnNkjv: And at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of Media, a scroll was found, and in it a record was written thus:
verses.textEnNlt: But it was at the fortress at Ecbatana in the province of Media that a scroll was found. This is what it said: "Memorandum:
verses.textEnNasb: And in Ecbatana, in the fortress which is in the province of Media, a scroll was found; and the following was written in it: "Memorandum—
verses.textEn: A scroll was found in the citadel of Ecbatana in the province of Media, and this was written on it: Memorandum:

verses.textZh: "古列王元年，古列王颁发有关在耶路撒冷神的殿的命令，要把这殿重建起来，作献祭的地方；要奠立殿的根基。殿高二十七公尺，宽二十七公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: "古列王元年，古列王颁发有关在耶路撒冷神的殿的命令，要把这殿重建起来，作献祭的地方；要奠立殿的根基。殿高二十七公尺，宽二十七公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 「塞鲁士王元年，他降旨论到耶路撒冷神的殿，要建造这殿为献祭之处，坚立殿的根基。殿高六十肘，宽六十肘，
verses.textEnNiv: In the first year of King Cyrus, the king issued a decree concerning the temple of God in Jerusalem: Let the temple be rebuilt as a place to present sacrifices, and let its foundations be laid. It is to be sixty cubits high and sixty cubits wide,
verses.textEnEsv: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king issued a decree: Concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, let the house be rebuilt, the place where sacrifices were offered, and let its foundations be retained. Its height shall be sixty cubits and its breadth sixty cubits,
verses.textEnNkjv: In the first year of King Cyrus, King Cyrus issued a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem: "Let the house be rebuilt, the place where they offered sacrifices; and let the foundations of it be firmly laid, its height sixty cubits and its width sixty cubits,
verses.textEnNlt: "In the first year of King Cyrus’s reign, a decree was sent out concerning the Temple of God at Jerusalem. "Let the Temple be rebuilt on the site where Jews used to offer their sacrifices, using the original foundations. Its height will be ninety feet, and its width will be ninety feet.
verses.textEnNasb: In the first year of King Cyrus, Cyrus the king issued a decree: ‘Concerning the house of God in Jerusalem, let the temple, the place where sacrifices are offered, be rebuilt, and let its foundations be repaired, its height being sixty cubits and its width sixty cubits,
verses.textEn: In the first year of King Cyrus, the king issued a decree concerning the temple of God in Jerusalem: Let the temple be rebuilt as a place to present sacrifices, and let its foundations be laid. It is to be sixty cubits high and sixty cubits wide,

verses.textZh: 三层光滑石块，一层新木头，所有费用由王库支付。

verses.textEnEsv: with three layers of great stones and one layer of timber. Let the cost be paid from the royal treasury.
verses.textEnNkjv: with three rows of heavy stones and one row of new timber. Let the expenses be paid from the king’s treasury.
verses.textEnNlt: Every three layers of specially prepared stones will be topped by a layer of timber. All expenses will be paid by the royal treasury.
verses.textEnNasb: with three layers of large stones and one layer of timber. And the cost is to be paid from the royal treasury.
verses.textEn: with three courses of large stones and one of timbers. The costs are to be paid by the royal treasury.

verses.textZh: 至于从前尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷的殿里掠夺，带到巴比伦的神殿中的金银器皿，都要归还，送到耶路撒冷的殿，各按原来的地方放在神的殿中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于从前尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷的殿里掠夺，带到巴比伦的神殿中的金银器皿，都要归还，送到耶路撒冷的殿，各按原来的地方放在神的殿中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且神殿的金银器皿，就是尼布甲尼撒从耶路撒冷的殿中掠到巴比伦的，要归还带到耶路撒冷的殿中，各按原处放在神的殿里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Also, the gold and silver articles of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, are to be returned to their places in the temple in Jerusalem; they are to be deposited in the house of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And also let the gold and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that is in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be restored and brought back to the temple that is in Jerusalem, each to its place. You shall put them in the house of God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also let the gold and silver articles of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple which is in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be restored and taken back to the temple which is in Jerusalem, each to its place; and deposit them in the house of God"—
verses.textEnNlt: Furthermore, the gold and silver cups, which were taken to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar from the Temple of God in Jerusalem, must be returned to Jerusalem and put back where they belong. Let them be taken back to the Temple of God."
verses.textEnNasb: Also the gold and silver utensils of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, are to be returned and brought to their places in the temple in Jerusalem; and you shall put them in the house of God.’
verses.textEn: Also, the gold and silver articles of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, are to be returned to their places in the temple in Jerusalem; they are to be deposited in the house of God.

verses.textZh: 于是大利乌王下令说："现在，河西那边的总督达乃和示他．波斯乃，以及你们的同僚，就是在河西那边的亚法萨迦人，你们要远离那里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是大利乌王下令说："现在，河西那边的总督达乃和示他．波斯乃，以及你们的同僚，就是在河西那边的亚法萨迦人，你们要远离那里；
verses.textZhCuv: 「现在河西的总督达乃和示他‧波斯乃，并你们的同党，就是住河西的亚法萨迦人，你们当远离他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Now then, Tattenai, governor of Trans-Euphrates, and Shethar-Bozenai and you other officials of that province, stay away from there.
verses.textEnEsv: "Now therefore, Tattenai, governor of the province Beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai, and your associates the governors who are in the province Beyond the River, keep away.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, Tattenai, governor of theregion beyond the River, and Shethar-Boznai, and your companions the Persians who are beyond the River, keep yourselves far from there.
verses.textEnNlt: So King Darius sent this message: "Now therefore, Tattenai, governor of the province west of the Euphrates River, and Shethar-bozenai, and your colleagues and other officials west of the Euphrates River—stay away from there!
verses.textEnNasb: "Now as for you, Tattenai, governor of the province beyond the Euphrates River, Shethar-bozenai, and your colleagues, the officials of the provinces beyond the River, stay away from there.
verses.textEn: Now then, Tattenai, governor of Trans-Euphrates, and Shethar-Bozenai and you other officials of that province, stay away from there.

verses.textZh: 不要干涉这神殿的工程，让犹大人的总督和犹大人的长老在原来的地方重建神的这殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要干涉这神殿的工程，让犹大人的总督和犹大人的长老在原来的地方重建神的这殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要拦阻神殿的工作，任凭犹大人的省长和犹大人的长老在原处建造神的这殿。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not interfere with the work on this temple of God. Let the governor of the Jews and the Jewish elders rebuild this house of God on its site.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the work on this house of God alone. Let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews rebuild this house of God on its site.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God on its site.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not disturb the construction of the Temple of God. Let it be rebuilt on its original site, and do not hinder the governor of Judah and the elders of the Jews in their work.
verses.textEnNasb: Leave that work on the house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews rebuild that house of God on its site.
verses.textEn: Do not interfere with the work on this temple of God. Let the governor of the Jews and the Jewish elders rebuild this house of God on its site.

verses.textZh: 我又下令你要协助这些犹大人的长老重建神的殿，你要作这事：从河西那边交给王库的税收中，拨出充足的经费给他们，免得工程停顿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又下令你要协助这些犹大人的长老重建神的殿，你要作这事：从河西那边交给王库的税收中，拨出充足的经费给他们，免得工程停顿。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又降旨，吩咐你们向犹大人的长老为建造神的殿当怎样行，就是从河西的款项中，急速拨取贡银作他们的经费，免得耽误工作。
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, I hereby decree what you are to do for these elders of the Jews in the construction of this house of God: Their expenses are to be fully paid out of the royal treasury, from the revenues of Trans-Euphrates, so that the work will not stop.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, I make a decree regarding what you shall do for these elders of the Jews for the rebuilding of this house of God. The cost is to be paid to these men in full and without delay from the royal revenue, the tribute of the province from Beyond the River.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover I issue a decree asto what you shall do for the elders of these Jews, for the building of this house of God: Let the cost be paid at the king’s expense from taxes ontheregion beyond the River; this is to be given immediately to these men, so that they are not hindered.
verses.textEnNlt: "Moreover, I hereby decree that you are to help these elders of the Jews as they rebuild this Temple of God. You must pay the full construction costs, without delay, from my taxes collected in the province west of the Euphrates River so that the work will not be interrupted.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, I issue a decree concerning what you are to do for these elders of Judah in the rebuilding of that house of God: the full cost is to be paid to those people from the royal treasury out of the taxes of the provinces beyond the Euphrates River, and that without interruption.
verses.textEn: Moreover, I hereby decree what you are to do for these elders of the Jews in the construction of this house of God: Their expenses are to be fully paid out of the royal treasury, from the revenues of Trans-Euphrates, so that the work will not stop.

verses.textZh: 他们需用的甚么东西，包括作燔祭献给天上神的公牛犊、公绵羊和绵羊羔；还有麦子、盐、酒和油，都要照着在耶路撒冷的祭司们所说，天天供给他们，不可疏忽，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们需用的甚么东西，包括作燔祭献给天上神的公牛犊、公绵羊和绵羊羔；还有麦子、盐、酒和油，都要照着在耶路撒冷的祭司们所说，天天供给他们，不可疏忽，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们与天上的神献燔祭所需用的公牛犊、公绵羊、绵羊羔，并所用的麦子、盐、酒、油，都要照耶路撒冷祭司的话，每日供给他们，不得有误；
verses.textEnNiv: Whatever is needed—young bulls, rams, male lambs for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, and wheat, salt, wine and olive oil, as requested by the priests in Jerusalem—must be given them daily without fail,
verses.textEnEsv: And whatever is needed—bulls, rams, or sheep for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, or oil, as the priests at Jerusalem require—let that be given to them day by day without fail,
verses.textEnNkjv: And whatever they need—young bulls, rams, and lambs for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the request of the priests who are in Jerusalem—let it be given them day by day without fail,
verses.textEnNlt: "Give the priests in Jerusalem whatever is needed in the way of young bulls, rams, and male lambs for the burnt offerings presented to the God of heaven. And without fail, provide them with as much wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil as they need each day.
verses.textEnNasb: And whatever is needed, bulls, rams, and lambs for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, and wheat, salt, wine, and anointing oil, as the priests in Jerusalem order, it is to be given to them daily without fail,
verses.textEn: Whatever is needed—young bulls, rams, male lambs for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, and wheat, salt, wine and olive oil, as requested by the priests in Jerusalem—must be given them daily without fail,

verses.textZh: 好让他们可以献馨香的祭给天上的神，为王和王的子孙祈求长寿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好让他们可以献馨香的祭给天上的神，为王和王的子孙祈求长寿。
verses.textZhCuv: 好叫他们献馨香的祭给天上的神，又为王和王众子的寿命祈祷。
verses.textEnNiv: so that they may offer sacrifices pleasing to the God of heaven and pray for the well-being of the king and his sons.
verses.textEnEsv: that they may offer pleasing sacrifices to the God of heaven and pray for the life of the king and his sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: that they may offer sacrifices of sweet aroma to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king and his sons.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they will be able to offer acceptable sacrifices to the God of heaven and pray for the welfare of the king and his sons.
verses.textEnNasb: so that they may offer acceptable sacrifices to the God of heaven and pray for the lives of the king and his sons.
verses.textEn: so that they may offer sacrifices pleasing to the God of heaven and pray for the well-being of the king and his sons.

verses.textZh: 我又下令：无论甚么人更改这命令，就要从他的房屋中拆出一根梁木，把他挂起，钉在木上；又使他的房屋成为粪堆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又下令：无论甚么人更改这命令，就要从他的房屋中拆出一根梁木，把他挂起，钉在木上；又使他的房屋成为粪堆。
verses.textZhCuv: 我再降旨，无论谁更改这命令，必从他房屋中拆出一根梁来，把他举起，悬在其上，又使他的房屋成为粪堆。
verses.textEnNiv: Furthermore, I decree that if anyone defies this edict, a beam is to be pulled from their house and they are to be impaled on it. And for this crime their house is to be made a pile of rubble.
verses.textEnEsv: Also I make a decree that if anyone alters this edict, a beam shall be pulled out of his house, and he shall be impaled on it, and his house shall be made a dunghill.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also I issue a decree that whoever alters this edict, let a timber be pulled from his house and erected, and let him be hanged on it; and let his house be made a refuse heap because of this.
verses.textEnNlt: "Those who violate this decree in any way will have a beam pulled from their house. Then they will be lifted up and impaled on it, and their house will be reduced to a pile of rubble.
verses.textEnNasb: And I issued a decree that any person who violates this decree, a timber shall be pulled out of his house and he shall be impaled on it; and his house shall be turned into a refuse heap on account of this.
verses.textEn: Furthermore, I decree that if anyone defies this edict, a beam is to be pulled from their house and they are to be impaled on it. And for this crime their house is to be made a pile of rubble.

verses.textZh: 愿那使自己的名居住在那里的神，毁灭所有伸手更改这命令，或要毁坏这在耶路撒冷神的殿的君王和人民。我大利乌下令，必须彻底遵行。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那使自己的名居住在那里的神，毁灭所有伸手更改这命令，或要毁坏这在耶路撒冷神的殿的君王和人民。我大利乌下令，必须彻底遵行。"
verses.textZhCuv: 若有王和民伸手更改这命令，拆毁这殿，愿那使耶路撒冷的殿作为他名居所的神将他们灭绝。我－大流士降这旨意，当速速遵行。」
verses.textEnNiv: May God, who has caused his Name to dwell there, overthrow any king or people who lifts a hand to change this decree or to destroy this temple in Jerusalem. I Darius have decreed it. Let it be carried out with diligence.
verses.textEnEsv: May the God who has caused his name to dwell there overthrow any king or people who shall put out a hand to alter this, or to destroy this house of God that is in Jerusalem. I Darius make a decree; let it be done with all diligence."
verses.textEnNkjv: And may the God who causes His name to dwell there destroy any king or people who put their hand to alter it, or to destroy this house of God which is in Jerusalem. I Darius issue a decree; let it be done diligently.
verses.textEnNlt: May the God who has chosen the city of Jerusalem as the place to honor his name destroy any king or nation that violates this command and destroys this Temple. "I, Darius, have issued this decree. Let it be obeyed with all diligence."
verses.textEnNasb: May the God who has caused His name to dwell there overthrow any king or people who attempts to change it, so as to destroy that house of God in Jerusalem. I, Darius, have issued this decree; it is to be carried out with all diligence!"
verses.textEn: May God, who has caused his Name to dwell there, overthrow any king or people who lifts a hand to change this decree or to destroy this temple in Jerusalem. I Darius have decreed it. Let it be carried out with diligence.

verses.textZh: 于是河西那边的总督达乃、示他．波斯乃和他们的同僚，彻底遵照大利乌王的指示。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是河西那边的总督达乃、示他．波斯乃和他们的同僚，彻底遵照大利乌王的指示。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，河西总督达乃和示他‧波斯乃，并他们的同党，因大流士王所发的命令，就急速遵行。
verses.textEnNiv: Then, because of the decree King Darius had sent, Tattenai, governor of Trans-Euphrates, and Shethar-Bozenai and their associates carried it out with diligence.
verses.textEnEsv: Then, according to the word sent by Darius the king, Tattenai, the governor of the province Beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates did with all diligence what Darius the king had ordered.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Tattenai, governor of theregion beyond the River, Shethar-Boznai, and their companions diligently did according to what King Darius had sent.
verses.textEnNlt: Tattenai, governor of the province west of the Euphrates River, and Shethar-bozenai and their colleagues complied at once with the command of King Darius.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Tattenai, the governor of the province beyond the Euphrates River, Shethar-bozenai, and their colleagues carried out the decree with all diligence, just as King Darius had ordered.
verses.textEn: Then, because of the decree King Darius had sent, Tattenai, governor of Trans-Euphrates, and Shethar-Bozenai and their associates carried it out with diligence.

verses.textZh: 犹大人的长老因着哈该先知和易多的孙子撒迦利亚的信息，迅速重建。他们遵照以色列神的命令，波斯王古列、大利乌和亚达薛西的命令，完成重建圣殿的工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人的长老因着哈该先知和易多的孙子撒迦利亚的信息，迅速重建。他们遵照以色列神的命令，波斯王古列、大利乌和亚达薛西的命令，完成重建圣殿的工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大长老因先知哈该和易多的孙子撒迦利亚所说劝勉的话就建造这殿，凡事亨通。他们遵着以色列神的命令和波斯王塞鲁士、大流士、亚达薛西的旨意，建造完毕。
verses.textEnNiv: So the elders of the Jews continued to build and prosper under the preaching of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah, a descendant of Iddo. They finished building the temple according to the command of the God of Israel and the decrees of Cyrus, Darius and Artaxerxes, kings of Persia.
verses.textEnEsv: And the elders of the Jews built and prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. They finished their building by decree of the God of Israel and by decree of Cyrus and Darius and Artaxerxes king of Persia;
verses.textEnNkjv: So the elders of the Jews built, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they built and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the command of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Jewish elders continued their work, and they were greatly encouraged by the preaching of the prophets Haggai and Zechariah son of Iddo. The Temple was finally finished, as had been commanded by the God of Israel and decreed by Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes, the kings of Persia.
verses.textEnNasb: And the elders of the Jews were successful in building through the prophecy of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they finished building following the command of the God of Israel and the decree of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
verses.textEn: So the elders of the Jews continued to build and prosper under the preaching of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah, a descendant of Iddo. They finished building the temple according to the command of the God of Israel and the decrees of Cyrus, Darius and Artaxerxes, kings of Persia.

verses.textZh: 这殿在大利乌王在位的第六年亚达月初三日，完成了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这殿在大利乌王在位的第六年亚达月初三日，完成了。
verses.textZhCuv: 大流士王第六年，亚达月初三日，这殿修成了。
verses.textEnNiv: The temple was completed on the third day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.
verses.textEnEsv: and this house was finished on the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the temple was finished on the third day of the month of Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.
verses.textEnNlt: The Temple was completed on March 12, during the sixth year of King Darius’s reign.
verses.textEnNasb: Now this temple was completed on the third day of the month Adar; it was the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.
verses.textEn: The temple was completed on the third day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.

verses.textZh: 以色列祭司和利未人，以及其余被掳归回的人都欢欢喜喜举行奉献这神殿的典礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列祭司和利未人，以及其余被掳归回的人都欢欢喜喜举行奉献这神殿的典礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的祭司和利未人，并其余被掳归回的人都欢欢喜喜地行奉献神殿的礼。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the people of Israel—the priests, the Levites and the rest of the exiles—celebrated the dedication of the house of God with joy.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel, the priests and the Levites, and the rest of the returned exiles, celebrated the dedication of this house of God with joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Israel, the priests and the Levites and the rest of the descendants of the captivity, celebrated the dedication of this house of God with joy.
verses.textEnNlt: The Temple of God was then dedicated with great joy by the people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the people who had returned from exile.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the exiles, celebrated the dedication of this house of God with joy.
verses.textEn: Then the people of Israel—the priests, the Levites and the rest of the exiles—celebrated the dedication of the house of God with joy.

verses.textZh: 在奉献这神殿的典礼中，他们献上公牛一百头、公绵羊二百只、绵羊羔四百只；又照着以色列支派的数目献上公山羊十二只，作全以色列的赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在奉献这神殿的典礼中，他们献上公牛一百头、公绵羊二百只、绵羊羔四百只；又照着以色列支派的数目献上公山羊十二只，作全以色列的赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 行奉献神殿的礼就献公牛一百只，公绵羊二百只，绵羊羔四百只，又照以色列支派的数目献公山羊十二只，为以色列众人作赎罪祭；
verses.textEnNiv: For the dedication of this house of God they offered a hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred male lambs and, as a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, one for each of the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: They offered at the dedication of this house of God 100 bulls, 200 rams, 400 lambs, and as a sin offering for all Israel 12 male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they offered sacrifices at the dedication of this house of God, one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and as a sin offering for all Israel twelve male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: During the dedication ceremony for the Temple of God, 100 young bulls, 200 rams, and 400 male lambs were sacrificed. And 12 male goats were presented as a sin offering for the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: They offered for the dedication of this temple of God a hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and as a sin offering for all Israel twelve male goats, corresponding to the number of the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEn: For the dedication of this house of God they offered a hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred male lambs and, as a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, one for each of the tribes of Israel.

verses.textZh: 他们又照着摩西书上所写，委派祭司按着编制，利未人按着班次，在耶路撒冷神的殿中事奉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又照着摩西书上所写，委派祭司按着编制，利未人按着班次，在耶路撒冷神的殿中事奉。
verses.textZhCuv: 且派祭司和利未人按着班次在耶路撒冷事奉神，是照摩西律法书上所写的。
verses.textEnNiv: And they installed the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their groups for the service of God at Jerusalem, according to what is written in the Book of Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And they set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their divisions, for the service of God at Jerusalem, as it is written in the Book of Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: They assigned the priests to their divisions and the Levites to their divisions, over the service of God in Jerusalem, as it is written in the Book of Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the priests and Levites were divided into their various divisions to serve at the Temple of God in Jerusalem, as prescribed in the Book of Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they appointed the priests to their divisions and the Levites in their sections for the service of God in Jerusalem, as it is written in the Book of Moses.
verses.textEn: And they installed the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their groups for the service of God at Jerusalem, according to what is written in the Book of Moses.

verses.textZh: 正月十四日，被掳归回的人守逾越节。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正月十四日，被掳归回的人守逾越节。
verses.textZhCuv: 正月十四日，被掳归回的人守逾越节。
verses.textEnNiv: On the fourteenth day of the first month, the exiles celebrated the Passover.
verses.textEnEsv: On the fourteenth day of the first month, the returned exiles kept the Passover.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the descendants of the captivity kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.textEnNlt: On April 21 the returned exiles celebrated Passover.
verses.textEnNasb: The exiles held the Passover on the fourteenth of the first month.
verses.textEn: On the fourteenth day of the first month, the exiles celebrated the Passover.

verses.textZh: 祭司和利未人一起行洁净仪式，他们就全都洁净了；于是利未人为所有被掳归回的人和他们作祭司的众亲族，以及他们自己，宰杀了逾越节的羊羔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司和利未人一起行洁净仪式，他们就全都洁净了；于是利未人为所有被掳归回的人和他们作祭司的众亲族，以及他们自己，宰杀了逾越节的羊羔。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来，祭司和利未人一同自洁，无一人不洁净。利未人为被掳归回的众人和他们的弟兄众祭司，并为自己宰逾越节的羊羔。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests and Levites had purified themselves and were all ceremonially clean. The Levites slaughtered the Passover lamb for all the exiles, for their relatives the priests and for themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: For the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together; all of them were clean. So they slaughtered the Passover lamb for all the returned exiles, for their fellow priests, and for themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the priests and the Levites had purified themselves; all of them wereritually clean. And they slaughtered the Passover lambs for all the descendants of the captivity, for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests and Levites had purified themselves and were ceremonially clean. So they slaughtered the Passover lamb for all the returned exiles, for their fellow priests, and for themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: For the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together; all of them were pure. Then they slaughtered the Passover lambs for all the exiles, both for their brothers the priests and for themselves.
verses.textEn: The priests and Levites had purified themselves and were all ceremonially clean. The Levites slaughtered the Passover lamb for all the exiles, for their relatives the priests and for themselves.

verses.textZh: 被掳归回的以色列人和所有脱离当地民族的污秽的人，一同吃这羊羔，寻求耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 被掳归回的以色列人和所有脱离当地民族的污秽的人，一同吃这羊羔，寻求耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 从掳到之地归回的以色列人和一切除掉所染外邦人污秽、归附他们、要寻求耶和华－以色列神的人都吃这羊羔，
verses.textEnNiv: So the Israelites who had returned from the exile ate it, together with all who had separated themselves from the unclean practices of their Gentile neighbors in order to seek the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: It was eaten by the people of Israel who had returned from exile, and also by every one who had joined them and separated himself from the uncleanness of the peoples of the land to worship the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Israel who had returned from the captivity ate together with all who had separated themselves from the filth of the nations of the land in order to seek the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The Passover meal was eaten by the people of Israel who had returned from exile and by the others in the land who had turned from their corrupt practices to worship the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel who returned from exile and all those who had separated themselves from the impurity of the nations of the land to join them, to seek the Lord God of Israel, ate the Passover.
verses.textEn: So the Israelites who had returned from the exile ate it, together with all who had separated themselves from the unclean practices of their Gentile neighbors in order to seek the Lord , the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 他们欢欢喜喜地守除酵节七天，因为耶和华使他们欢喜，又使亚述王的心转向他们，坚固他们的手作以色列神殿的工程。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们欢欢喜喜地守除酵节七天，因为耶和华使他们欢喜，又使亚述王的心转向他们，坚固他们的手作以色列神殿的工程。
verses.textZhCuv: 欢欢喜喜地守除酵节七日；因为耶和华使他们欢喜，又使亚述王的心转向他们，坚固他们的手，作以色列神殿的工程。
verses.textEnNiv: For seven days they celebrated with joy the Festival of Unleavened Bread, because the Lord had filled them with joy by changing the attitude of the king of Assyria so that he assisted them in the work on the house of God, the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And they kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread seven days with joy, for the Lord had made them joyful and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, so that he aided them in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread seven days with joy; for the Lord made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they celebrated the Festival of Unleavened Bread for seven days. There was great joy throughout the land because the Lord had caused the king of Assyria to be favorable to them, so that he helped them to rebuild the Temple of God, the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And they held the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days with joy, because the Lord had made them happy, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward them to encourage them in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
verses.textEn: For seven days they celebrated with joy the Festival of Unleavened Bread, because the Lord had filled them with joy by changing the attitude of the king of Assyria so that he assisted them in the work on the house of God, the God of Israel.

verses.textEn: After these things, during the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

verses.textZh: 这位以斯拉是一位经学家，精通耶和华以色列的神赐给摩西的律法；因为耶和华他神的手帮助他，所以王赐他所求的一切，他就从巴比伦上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这位以斯拉是一位经学家，精通耶和华以色列的神赐给摩西的律法；因为耶和华他神的手帮助他，所以王赐他所求的一切，他就从巴比伦上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 这以斯拉从巴比伦上来，他是敏捷的文士，通达耶和华－以色列神所赐摩西的律法书。王允准他一切所求的，是因耶和华－他神的手帮助他。
verses.textEnNiv: this Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a teacher well versed in the Law of Moses, which the Lord , the God of Israel, had given. The king had granted him everything he asked, for the hand of the Lord his God was on him.
verses.textEnEsv: this Ezra went up from Babylonia. He was a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses that the Lord , the God of Israel, had given, and the king granted him all that he asked, for the hand of the Lord his God was on him.
verses.textEnNkjv: this Ezra came up from Babylon; and he was a skilled scribe in the Law of Moses, which the Lord God of Israel had given. The king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the Lord his God upon him.
verses.textEnNlt: This Ezra was a scribe who was well versed in the Law of Moses, which the Lord , the God of Israel, had given to the people of Israel. He came up to Jerusalem from Babylon, and the king gave him everything he asked for, because the gracious hand of the Lord his God was on him.
verses.textEnNasb: So this Ezra went up from Babylon, and he was a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses, which the Lord God of Israel had given; and the king granted him all he requested because the hand of the Lord his God was upon him.
verses.textEn: this Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a teacher well versed in the Law of Moses, which the Lord , the God of Israel, had given. The king had granted him everything he asked, for the hand of the Lord his God was on him.

verses.textZh: 在亚达薛西王第七年，一些以色列人和一些祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守门的和作殿役的，和他一起上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在亚达薛西王第七年，一些以色列人和一些祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守门的和作殿役的，和他一起上耶路撒冷去。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚达薛西王第七年，以色列人、祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守门的、尼提宁，有上耶路撒冷的。
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the Israelites, including priests, Levites, musicians, gatekeepers and temple servants, also came up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes.
verses.textEnEsv: And there went up also to Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king, some of the people of Israel, and some of the priests and Levites, the singers and gatekeepers, and the temple servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: Some of the children of Israel, the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the Nethinim came up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the people of Israel, as well as some of the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, and Temple servants, traveled up to Jerusalem with him in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes’ reign.
verses.textEnNasb: Some of the sons of Israel and some of the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes.
verses.textEn: Some of the Israelites, including priests, Levites, musicians, gatekeepers and temple servants, also came up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes.

verses.textZh: 王第七年五月来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王第七年五月来到耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 王第七年五月，以斯拉到了耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: Ezra arrived in Jerusalem in the fifth month of the seventh year of the king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ezra came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ezra came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.
verses.textEnNlt: Ezra arrived in Jerusalem in August of that year.
verses.textEnNasb: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.
verses.textEn: Ezra arrived in Jerusalem in the fifth month of the seventh year of the king.

verses.textZh: 正月初一，以斯拉开始从巴比伦上来；五月初一来到耶路撒冷，他神施恩的手帮助他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 正月初一，以斯拉开始从巴比伦上来；五月初一来到耶路撒冷，他神施恩的手帮助他，
verses.textZhCuv: 正月初一日，他从巴比伦起程；因他神施恩的手帮助他，五月初一日就到了耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: He had begun his journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, for the gracious hand of his God was on him.
verses.textEnEsv: For on the first day of the first month he began to go up from Babylonia, and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, for the good hand of his God was on him.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the first day of the first month he began his journey from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
verses.textEnNlt: He had arranged to leave Babylon on April 8, the first day of the new year, and he arrived at Jerusalem on August 4, for the gracious hand of his God was on him.
verses.textEnNasb: For on the first day of the first month he began to go up from Babylon; and on the first of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, because the good hand of his God was upon him.
verses.textEn: He had begun his journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, for the gracious hand of his God was on him.

verses.textZh: 因为以斯拉专心寻求研究耶和华的律法，并且遵行，在以色列中教导律例和典章。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为以斯拉专心寻求研究耶和华的律法，并且遵行，在以色列中教导律例和典章。
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯拉定志考究遵行耶和华的律法，又将律例典章教训以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: For Ezra had devoted himself to the study and observance of the Law of the Lord , and to teaching its decrees and laws in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: For Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the Lord , and to do it and to teach his statutes and rules in Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the Law of the Lord, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: This was because Ezra had determined to study and obey the Law of the Lord and to teach those decrees and regulations to the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: For Ezra had firmly resolved to study the Law of the Lord and to practice it, and to teach His statutes and ordinances in Israel.
verses.textEn: For Ezra had devoted himself to the study and observance of the Law of the Lord , and to teaching its decrees and laws in Israel.

verses.textZh: 亚达薛西王颁发谕旨给以斯拉；以斯拉是一位祭司和经学家，精通耶和华的诫命和赐给以色列之律例；谕旨内容是这样：
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚达薛西王颁发谕旨给以斯拉；以斯拉是一位祭司和经学家，精通耶和华的诫命和赐给以色列之律例；谕旨内容是这样：
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司以斯拉是通达耶和华诫命和赐以色列之律例的文士。亚达薛西王赐给他们谕旨，上面写着说：
verses.textEnNiv: This is a copy of the letter King Artaxerxes had given to Ezra the priest, a teacher of the Law, a man learned in matters concerning the commands and decrees of the Lord for Israel:
verses.textEnEsv: This is a copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, a man learned in matters of the commandments of the Lord and his statutes for Israel:
verses.textEnNkjv: This is a copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave Ezra the priest, the scribe, expert in the words of the commandments of the Lord, and of His statutes to Israel:
verses.textEnNlt: King Artaxerxes had given a copy of the following letter to Ezra, the priest and scribe who studied and taught the commands and decrees of the Lord to Israel:
verses.textEnNasb: Now this is the copy of the letter which King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, learned in the words of the commandments of the Lord and His statutes to Israel:
verses.textEn: This is a copy of the letter King Artaxerxes had given to Ezra the priest, a teacher of the Law, a man learned in matters concerning the commands and decrees of the Lord for Israel:

verses.textZh: "诸王之王亚达薛西赐谕旨给以斯拉祭司，精通天上神律法的经学家，愿你平安。
verses.textZhCnvs: "诸王之王亚达薛西赐谕旨给以斯拉祭司，精通天上神律法的经学家，愿你平安。
verses.textZhCuv: 「诸王之王亚达薛西，达于祭司以斯拉通达天上神律法大德的文士，云云。
verses.textEnNiv: Artaxerxes, king of kings, To Ezra the priest, teacher of the Law of the God of heaven: Greetings.
verses.textEnEsv: "Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven. Peace. And now
verses.textEnNkjv: Artaxerxes, king of kings, To Ezra the priest, a scribe of the Law of the God of heaven: Perfect peace, and so forth.
verses.textEnNlt: "From Artaxerxes, the king of kings, to Ezra the priest, the teacher of the law of the God of heaven. Greetings.
verses.textEnNasb: " Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven, perfect peace. And now
verses.textEn: Artaxerxes, king of kings, To Ezra the priest, teacher of the Law of the God of heaven: Greetings.

verses.textZh: 现在我下令：住在我国中的以色列人中，愿意上到耶路撒冷去的祭司和利未人，他们都可以与你同去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我下令：住在我国中的以色列人中，愿意上到耶路撒冷去的祭司和利未人，他们都可以与你同去。
verses.textZhCuv: 住在我国中的以色列人、祭司、利未人，凡甘心上耶路撒冷去的，我降旨准他们与你同去。
verses.textEnNiv: Now I decree that any of the Israelites in my kingdom, including priests and Levites, who volunteer to go to Jerusalem with you, may go.
verses.textEnEsv: I make a decree that anyone of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom, who freely offers to go to Jerusalem, may go with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I issue a decree that all those of the people of Israel and the priests and Levites in my realm, who volunteer to go up to Jerusalem, may go with you.
verses.textEnNlt: "I decree that any of the people of Israel in my kingdom, including the priests and Levites, may volunteer to return to Jerusalem with you.
verses.textEnNasb: I have issued a decree that any of the people of Israel and their priests and the Levites in my kingdom who are willing to go to Jerusalem, may go with you.
verses.textEn: Now I decree that any of the Israelites in my kingdom, including priests and Levites, who volunteer to go to Jerusalem with you, may go.

verses.textZh: 你既然是王和他七位顾问所派去的，就要照着你手中神的律法书，查察犹大和耶路撒冷的情况。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你既然是王和他七位顾问所派去的，就要照着你手中神的律法书，查察犹大和耶路撒冷的情况。
verses.textZhCuv: 王与七个谋士既然差你去，照你手中神的律法书察问犹大和耶路撒冷的景况；
verses.textEnNiv: You are sent by the king and his seven advisers to inquire about Judah and Jerusalem with regard to the Law of your God, which is in your hand.
verses.textEnEsv: For you are sent by the king and his seven counselors to make inquiries about Judah and Jerusalem according to the Law of your God, which is in your hand,
verses.textEnNkjv: And whereas you are being sent by the king and his seven counselors to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, with regard to the Law of your God which is in your hand;
verses.textEnNlt: I and my council of seven hereby instruct you to conduct an inquiry into the situation in Judah and Jerusalem, based on your God’s law, which is in your hand.
verses.textEnNasb: Since you are sent on the part of the king and his seven advisers to inquire about Judah and Jerusalem according to the Law of your God which is in your hand,
verses.textEn: You are sent by the king and his seven advisers to inquire about Judah and Jerusalem with regard to the Law of your God, which is in your hand.

verses.textZh: 你要把王和他顾问甘心献的金银带去，奉献给住在耶路撒冷之以色列的神；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把王和他顾问甘心献的金银带去，奉献给住在耶路撒冷之以色列的神；
verses.textZhCuv: 又带金银，就是王和谋士甘心献给住耶路撒冷、以色列神的，
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, you are to take with you the silver and gold that the king and his advisers have freely given to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,
verses.textEnEsv: and also to carry the silver and gold that the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNkjv: and whereasyouare to carry the silver and gold which the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem;
verses.textEnNlt: We also commission you to take with you silver and gold, which we are freely presenting as an offering to the God of Israel who lives in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: and to bring the silver and gold, which the king and his advisers have voluntarily given to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,
verses.textEn: Moreover, you are to take with you the silver and gold that the king and his advisers have freely given to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,

verses.textZh: 也要带着你在巴比伦全省所得的金银，连同人民和祭司甘心乐意献给在耶路撒冷神的殿的礼物，
verses.textZhCnvs: 也要带着你在巴比伦全省所得的金银，连同人民和祭司甘心乐意献给在耶路撒冷神的殿的礼物，
verses.textZhCuv: 并带你在巴比伦全省所得的金银，和百姓、祭司乐意献给耶路撒冷－他们神殿的礼物。
verses.textEnNiv: together with all the silver and gold you may obtain from the province of Babylon, as well as the freewill offerings of the people and priests for the temple of their God in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: with all the silver and gold that you shall find in the whole province of Babylonia, and with the freewill offerings of the people and the priests, vowed willingly for the house of their God that is in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: and whereas all the silver and gold that you may find in all the province of Babylon, along with the freewill offering of the people and the priests, aretobe freely offered for the house of their God in Jerusalem—
verses.textEnNlt: "Furthermore, you are to take any silver and gold that you may obtain from the province of Babylon, as well as the voluntary offerings of the people and the priests that are presented for the Temple of their God in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: with all the silver and gold which you find in the entire province of Babylon, along with the voluntary offering of the people and of the priests, who offered willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem;
verses.textEn: together with all the silver and gold you may obtain from the province of Babylon, as well as the freewill offerings of the people and priests for the temple of their God in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 使你可以用这些银子审慎地购买公牛、公绵羊、绵羊羔，以及与祭牲同献的素祭和奠祭，献在耶路撒冷你们神的殿的祭坛上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使你可以用这些银子审慎地购买公牛、公绵羊、绵羊羔，以及与祭牲同献的素祭和奠祭，献在耶路撒冷你们神的殿的祭坛上。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你当用这金银，急速买公牛、公绵羊、绵羊羔，和同献的素祭奠祭之物，献在耶路撒冷－你们神殿的坛上。
verses.textEnNiv: With this money be sure to buy bulls, rams and male lambs, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and sacrifice them on the altar of the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: With this money, then, you shall with all diligence buy bulls, rams, and lambs, with their grain offerings and their drink offerings, and you shall offer them on the altar of the house of your God that is in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: now therefore, be careful to buy with this money bulls, rams, and lambs, with their grain offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them on the altar of the house of your God in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: These donations are to be used specifically for the purchase of bulls, rams, male lambs, and the appropriate grain offerings and liquid offerings, all of which will be offered on the altar of the Temple of your God in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: with this money, therefore, you shall diligently buy bulls, rams, and lambs, with their grain offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them on the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: With this money be sure to buy bulls, rams and male lambs, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and sacrifice them on the altar of the temple of your God in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 剩余的金银，你和你的族人看怎么办好，就怎么用；只要照着你们神的旨意去作就是了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 剩余的金银，你和你的族人看怎么办好，就怎么用；只要照着你们神的旨意去作就是了。
verses.textZhCuv: 剩下的金银，你和你的弟兄看着怎样好，就怎样用，总要遵着你们神的旨意。
verses.textEnNiv: You and your fellow Israelites may then do whatever seems best with the rest of the silver and gold, in accordance with the will of your God.
verses.textEnEsv: Whatever seems good to you and your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and gold, you may do, according to the will of your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whatever seems good to you and your brethren to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, do it according to the will of your God.
verses.textEnNlt: Any silver and gold that is left over may be used in whatever way you and your colleagues feel is the will of your God.
verses.textEnNasb: And whatever seems good to you and your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and gold, you may do according to the will of your God.
verses.textEn: You and your fellow Israelites may then do whatever seems best with the rest of the silver and gold, in accordance with the will of your God.

verses.textZh: 至于交给你为你神殿中事奉用的器皿，你要放在耶路撒冷的神面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于交给你为你神殿中事奉用的器皿，你要放在耶路撒冷的神面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 所交给你神殿中使用的器皿，你要交在耶路撒冷神面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Deliver to the God of Jerusalem all the articles entrusted to you for worship in the temple of your God.
verses.textEnEsv: The vessels that have been given you for the service of the house of your God, you shall deliver before the God of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the articles that are given to you for the service of the house of your God, deliver in full before the God of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: "But as for the cups we are entrusting to you for the service of the Temple of your God, deliver them all to the God of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Also the utensils which are given to you for the service of the house of your God, deliver in full before the God of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Deliver to the God of Jerusalem all the articles entrusted to you for worship in the temple of your God.

verses.textZh: 如果你需要支付你神的殿其余的费用，你可以从王的库房里支付。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你需要支付你神的殿其余的费用，你可以从王的库房里支付。
verses.textZhCuv: 你神殿里若再有需用的经费，你可以从王的府库里支取。
verses.textEnNiv: And anything else needed for the temple of your God that you are responsible to supply, you may provide from the royal treasury.
verses.textEnEsv: And whatever else is required for the house of your God, which it falls to you to provide, you may provide it out of the king’s treasury.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whatever more may be needed for the house of your God, which you may have occasion to provide, pay forit from the king’s treasury.
verses.textEnNlt: If you need anything else for your God’s Temple or for any similar needs, you may take it from the royal treasury.
verses.textEnNasb: And the rest of the needs of the house of your God, for which it may be incumbent upon you to provide, provide for them from the royal treasury.
verses.textEn: And anything else needed for the temple of your God that you are responsible to supply, you may provide from the royal treasury.

verses.textZh: 我亚达薛西王下令给在河西那边所有的库官：无论以斯拉祭司，这位精通天上神律法的经学家，向你们要求甚么，你们都要审慎照办。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我亚达薛西王下令给在河西那边所有的库官：无论以斯拉祭司，这位精通天上神律法的经学家，向你们要求甚么，你们都要审慎照办。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我－亚达薛西王又降旨与河西的一切库官，说：『通达天上神律法的文士祭司以斯拉，无论向你们要什么，你们要速速地备办，
verses.textEnNiv: Now I, King Artaxerxes, decree that all the treasurers of Trans-Euphrates are to provide with diligence whatever Ezra the priest, the teacher of the Law of the God of heaven, may ask of you—
verses.textEnEsv: "And I, Artaxerxes the king, make a decree to all the treasurers in the province Beyond the River: Whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven, requires of you, let it be done with all diligence,
verses.textEnNkjv: And I, even I, Artaxerxes the king, issue a decree to all the treasurers who areintheregion beyond the River, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven, may require of you, let it be done diligently,
verses.textEnNlt: "I, Artaxerxes the king, hereby send this decree to all the treasurers in the province west of the Euphrates River : ‘You are to give Ezra, the priest and teacher of the law of the God of heaven, whatever he requests of you.
verses.textEnNasb: "I myself, King Artaxerxes, issue a decree to all the treasurers who are in the provinces beyond the Euphrates River, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven, may require of you, it shall be done diligently,
verses.textEn: Now I, King Artaxerxes, decree that all the treasurers of Trans-Euphrates are to provide with diligence whatever Ezra the priest, the teacher of the Law of the God of heaven, may ask of you—

verses.textZh: 他可以要银子三千四百公斤，麦子一百公斤，酒二千二百公升，油二千二百公升，盐却不受限制。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他可以要银子三千四百公斤，麦子一百公斤，酒二千二百公升，油二千二百公升，盐却不受限制。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是银子直到一百他连得，麦子一百柯珥，酒一百罢特，油一百罢特，盐不计其数，也要给他。
verses.textEnNiv: up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred cors of wheat, a hundred baths of wine, a hundred baths of olive oil, and salt without limit.
verses.textEnEsv: up to 100 talents of silver, 100 cors of wheat, 100 baths of wine, 100 baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.
verses.textEnNkjv: up to one hundred talents of silver, one hundred kors of wheat, one hundred baths of wine, one hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribed limit.
verses.textEnNlt: You are to give him up to 7,500 pounds of silver, 500 bushels of wheat, 550 gallons of wine, 550 gallons of olive oil, and an unlimited supply of salt.
verses.textEnNasb: up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred kors of wheat, a hundred baths of wine, a hundred baths of anointing oil, and salt as needed.
verses.textEn: up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred cors of wheat, a hundred baths of wine, a hundred baths of olive oil, and salt without limit.

verses.textZh: 天上的神命令的，就要为天上神的殿热心去作，免得忿怒临到王和王的子孙的国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天上的神命令的，就要为天上神的殿热心去作，免得忿怒临到王和王的子孙的国。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡天上之神所吩咐的，当为天上神的殿详细办理。为何使忿怒临到王和王众子的国呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Whatever the God of heaven has prescribed, let it be done with diligence for the temple of the God of heaven. Why should his wrath fall on the realm of the king and of his sons?
verses.textEnEsv: Whatever is decreed by the God of heaven, let it be done in full for the house of the God of heaven, lest his wrath be against the realm of the king and his sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it diligently be done for the house of the God of heaven. For why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
verses.textEnNlt: Be careful to provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his Temple, for why should we risk bringing God’s anger against the realm of the king and his sons?
verses.textEnNasb: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, it shall be done with zeal for the house of the God of heaven, so that there will not be wrath against the kingdom of the king and his sons.
verses.textEn: Whatever the God of heaven has prescribed, let it be done with diligence for the temple of the God of heaven. Why should his wrath fall on the realm of the king and of his sons?

verses.textZh: 我要你们知道，凡是祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守门的，作殿役的和在这神的殿里作仆人的，都不可以向他们征收税款、贡物和粮食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要你们知道，凡是祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守门的，作殿役的和在这神的殿里作仆人的，都不可以向他们征收税款、贡物和粮食。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又晓谕你们，至于祭司、利未人、歌唱的、守门的，和尼提宁，并在神殿当差的人，不可叫他们进贡，交课，纳税。』
verses.textEnNiv: You are also to know that you have no authority to impose taxes, tribute or duty on any of the priests, Levites, musicians, gatekeepers, temple servants or other workers at this house of God.
verses.textEnEsv: We also notify you that it shall not be lawful to impose tribute, custom, or toll on anyone of the priests, the Levites, the singers, the doorkeepers, the temple servants, or other servants of this house of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also we inform you that it shall not be lawful to impose tax, tribute, or custom on any of the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, Nethinim, or servants of this house of God.
verses.textEnNlt: I also decree that no priest, Levite, singer, gatekeeper, Temple servant, or other worker in this Temple of God will be required to pay tribute, customs, or tolls of any kind.’
verses.textEnNasb: We also inform you that it is not allowed to impose tax, tribute, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, doorkeepers, temple servants, or other servants of this house of God.
verses.textEn: You are also to know that you have no authority to impose taxes, tribute or duty on any of the priests, Levites, musicians, gatekeepers, temple servants or other workers at this house of God.

verses.textZh: 至于你以斯拉，你要照着你手中神的智慧书，委任法官和官吏，治理在河西那边所有明白你神的律法的人民，那些不晓得律法的人，你要教导他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你以斯拉，你要照着你手中神的智慧书，委任法官和官吏，治理在河西那边所有明白你神的律法的人民，那些不晓得律法的人，你要教导他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以斯拉啊，要照着你神赐你的智慧，将所有明白你神律法的人立为士师、审判官，治理河西的百姓，使他们教训一切不明白神律法的人。
verses.textEnNiv: And you, Ezra, in accordance with the wisdom of your God, which you possess, appoint magistrates and judges to administer justice to all the people of Trans-Euphrates—all who know the laws of your God. And you are to teach any who do not know them.
verses.textEnEsv: "And you, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges who may judge all the people in the province Beyond the River, all such as know the laws of your God. And those who do not know them, you shall teach.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you, Ezra, according to your God-given wisdom, set magistrates and judges who may judge all the people who areintheregion beyond the River, all such as know the laws of your God; and teach those who do not know them.
verses.textEnNlt: "And you, Ezra, are to use the wisdom your God has given you to appoint magistrates and judges who know your God’s laws to govern all the people in the province west of the Euphrates River. Teach the law to anyone who does not know it.
verses.textEnNasb: "And you, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God which is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges so that they may judge all the people who are in the province beyond the Euphrates River, that is, all those who know the laws of your God; and you may teach anyone who is ignorant of them.
verses.textEn: And you, Ezra, in accordance with the wisdom of your God, which you possess, appoint magistrates and judges to administer justice to all the people of Trans-Euphrates—all who know the laws of your God. And you are to teach any who do not know them.

verses.textZh: 不遵守你神的律法和王的律法的，就要审慎地判决处分，或是处死、或是放逐、或是没收家产、或是囚禁。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不遵守你神的律法和王的律法的，就要审慎地判决处分，或是处死、或是放逐、或是没收家产、或是囚禁。"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡不遵行你神律法和王命令的人就当速速定他的罪，或治死，或充军，或抄家，或囚禁。」
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever does not obey the law of your God and the law of the king must surely be punished by death, banishment, confiscation of property, or imprisonment.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever will not obey the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be strictly executed on him, whether for death or for banishment or for confiscation of his goods or for imprisonment."
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever will not observe the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily on him, whether itbe death, or banishment, or confiscation of goods, or imprisonment.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who refuses to obey the law of your God and the law of the king will be punished immediately, either by death, banishment, confiscation of goods, or imprisonment."
verses.textEnNasb: And whoever does not comply with the Law of your God and the law of the king, judgment is to be executed upon him strictly, whether for death or for banishment, or for confiscation of property or for imprisonment."
verses.textEn: Whoever does not obey the law of your God and the law of the king must surely be punished by death, banishment, confiscation of property, or imprisonment.

verses.textZh: 以斯拉说："耶和华我们列祖的神是应该称颂的，因为他把这样的意念放在君王的心里，使他修饰那在耶路撒冷的耶和华的殿；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯拉说："耶和华我们列祖的神是应该称颂的，因为他把这样的意念放在君王的心里，使他修饰那在耶路撒冷的耶和华的殿；
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯拉说：「耶和华－我们列祖的神是应当称颂的！因他使王起这心意修饰耶路撒冷耶和华的殿，
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the Lord , the God of our ancestors, who has put it into the king’s heart to bring honor to the house of the Lord in Jerusalem in this way
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the Lord , the God of our fathers, who put such a thing as this into the heart of the king, to beautify the house of the Lord that is in Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the Lord God of our fathers, who has put suchathing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord , the God of our ancestors, who made the king want to beautify the Temple of the Lord in Jerusalem!
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the Lord, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to glorify the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem,
verses.textEn: Praise be to the Lord , the God of our ancestors, who has put it into the king’s heart to bring honor to the house of the Lord in Jerusalem in this way

verses.textZh: 又使我在王和谋士，以及王手下有权势的领袖面前蒙恩。因为耶和华我神的手帮助我，我就有勇气，召集以色列中一些首领，与我一同上来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又使我在王和谋士，以及王手下有权势的领袖面前蒙恩。因为耶和华我神的手帮助我，我就有勇气，召集以色列中一些首领，与我一同上来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又在王和谋士，并大能的军长面前施恩于我。因耶和华－我神的手帮助我，我就得以坚强，从以色列中招聚首领，与我一同上来。」
verses.textEnNiv: and who has extended his good favor to me before the king and his advisers and all the king’s powerful officials. Because the hand of the Lord my God was on me, I took courage and gathered leaders from Israel to go up with me.
verses.textEnEsv: and who extended to me his steadfast love before the king and his counselors, and before all the king’s mighty officers. I took courage, for the hand of the Lord my God was on me, and I gathered leading men from Israel to go up with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: and has extended mercy to me before the king and his counselors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. So I was encouraged, as the hand of the Lord my God was upon me; and I gathered leading men of Israel to go up with me.
verses.textEnNlt: And praise him for demonstrating such unfailing love to me by honoring me before the king, his council, and all his mighty nobles! I felt encouraged because the gracious hand of the Lord my God was on me. And I gathered some of the leaders of Israel to return with me to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: and has extended favor to me before the king and his counselors and before all the king’s mighty officials. So I was strengthened according to the hand of the Lord my God that was upon me, and I gathered leading men from Israel to go up with me.
verses.textEn: and who has extended his good favor to me before the king and his advisers and all the king’s powerful officials. Because the hand of the Lord my God was on me, I took courage and gathered leaders from Israel to go up with me.

verses.textZh: "亚达薛西王在位的时候，与我从巴比伦一同上来的人，他们的族长和他们的族谱记载如下：
verses.textZhCnvs: "亚达薛西王在位的时候，与我从巴比伦一同上来的人，他们的族长和他们的族谱记载如下：
verses.textZhCuv: 当亚达薛西王年间，同我从巴比伦上来的人，他们的族长和他们的家谱记在下面：
verses.textEnNiv: These are the family heads and those registered with them who came up with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes:
verses.textEnEsv: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylonia, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king:
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses, and thisis the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of King Artaxerxes:
verses.textEnNlt: Here is a list of the family leaders and the genealogies of those who came with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes:
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the heads of their fathers’ households and the genealogical enrollment of those who went up with me from Babylon in the reign of King Artaxerxes:
verses.textEn: These are the family heads and those registered with them who came up with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes:

verses.textZhCuv: 属巴录的后裔，就是示迦尼的子孙有撒迦利亚，同着他，按家谱计算，男丁一百五十人；

verses.textZhCnvs: 属以拦的子孙有亚他利雅的儿子耶筛亚，与他在一起的男丁有七十人。
verses.textZhCuv: 属以拦的子孙有亚他利雅的儿子耶筛亚，同着他有男丁七十；
verses.textEnNiv: of the descendants of Elam, Jeshaiah son of Athaliah, and with him 70 men;
verses.textEnEsv: Of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him 70 men.

verses.textEnNasb: and of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah and seventy males with him;
verses.textEn: of the descendants of Elam, Jeshaiah son of Athaliah, and with him 70 men;

verses.textZh: 属亚多尼干的子孙，就是最后的，他们的名字是：以利法列、耶利和示玛雅，与他们在一起的男丁有六十人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属亚多尼干的子孙，就是最后的，他们的名字是：以利法列、耶利和示玛雅，与他们在一起的男丁有六十人。
verses.textZhCuv: 属亚多尼干的子孙，就是末尾的，他们的名字是以利法列、耶利、示玛雅，同着他们有男丁六十；

verses.textEnEsv: Of the sons of Adonikam, those who came later, their names being Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah, and with them 60 men.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these—Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah—and with them sixty males;
verses.textEnNlt: From the family of Adonikam, who came later : Eliphelet, Jeuel, Shemaiah, and 60 other men.
verses.textEnNasb: and of the sons of Adonikam, the last ones, these being their names: Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and sixty males with them;
verses.textEn: of the descendants of Adonikam, the last ones, whose names were Eliphelet, Jeuel and Shemaiah, and with them 60 men;

verses.textEnEsv: Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zaccur, and with them 70 men.
verses.textEnNkjv: also of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.
verses.textEnNlt: From the family of Bigvai: Uthai, Zaccur, and 70 other men.
verses.textEnNasb: and of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud, and seventy males with them.
verses.textEn: of the descendants of Bigvai, Uthai and Zakkur, and with them 70 men.

verses.textZh: "我召集他们到那条流往亚哈瓦的河边；我们在那里安营住了三天。当我视察民众和祭司的时候，发现没有利未人在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我召集他们到那条流往亚哈瓦的河边；我们在那里安营住了三天。当我视察民众和祭司的时候，发现没有利未人在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我招聚这些人在流入亚哈瓦的河边，我们在那里住了三日。我查看百姓和祭司，见没有利未人在那里，
verses.textEnNiv: I assembled them at the canal that flows toward Ahava, and we camped there three days. When I checked among the people and the priests, I found no Levites there.
verses.textEnEsv: I gathered them to the river that runs to Ahava, and there we camped three days. As I reviewed the people and the priests, I found there none of the sons of Levi.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I gathered them by the river that flows to Ahava, and we camped there three days. And I looked among the people and the priests, and found none of the sons of Levi there.
verses.textEnNlt: I assembled the exiles at the Ahava Canal, and we camped there for three days while I went over the lists of the people and the priests who had arrived. I found that not one Levite had volunteered to come along.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I assembled them at the river that runs to Ahava, where we camped for three days; and when I paid close attention to the people and the priests, I did not find any Levites there.
verses.textEn: I assembled them at the canal that flows toward Ahava, and we camped there three days. When I checked among the people and the priests, I found no Levites there.

verses.textZh: 于是我把首领以利以谢、亚列、示玛雅、以利拿单、雅立、以利拿单、拿单、撒迦利亚和米书兰召来，也把有学问的教师约雅立和以利拿单召来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我把首领以利以谢、亚列、示玛雅、以利拿单、雅立、以利拿单、拿单、撒迦利亚和米书兰召来，也把有学问的教师约雅立和以利拿单召来，
verses.textZhCuv: 就召首领以利以谢、亚列、示玛雅、以利拿单、雅立、以利拿单、拿单、撒迦利亚、米书兰，又召教习约雅立和以利拿单。
verses.textEnNiv: So I summoned Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah and Meshullam, who were leaders, and Joiarib and Elnathan, who were men of learning,
verses.textEnEsv: Then I sent for Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, leading men, and for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were men of insight,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I sent for Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, leaders; also for Joiarib and Elnathan, men of understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: So I sent for Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, who were leaders of the people. I also sent for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were men of discernment.
verses.textEnNasb: So I sent for Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, leading men, and for Joiarib and Elnathan, teachers.
verses.textEn: So I summoned Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah and Meshullam, who were leaders, and Joiarib and Elnathan, who were men of learning,

verses.textZh: 差派他们到迦西斐雅的地方那里去见首领易多，又把他们在迦西斐雅的地方，对易多和他作殿役的亲族所当说的话都告诉他们，请他们为我们神的殿打发仆人到我们这里来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 差派他们到迦西斐雅的地方那里去见首领易多，又把他们在迦西斐雅的地方，对易多和他作殿役的亲族所当说的话都告诉他们，请他们为我们神的殿打发仆人到我们这里来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我打发他们往迦西斐雅地方去见那里的首领易多，又告诉他们当向易多和他的弟兄尼提宁说什么话，叫他们为我们神的殿带使用的人来。
verses.textEnNiv: and I ordered them to go to Iddo, the leader in Kasiphia. I told them what to say to Iddo and his fellow Levites, the temple servants in Kasiphia, so that they might bring attendants to us for the house of our God.
verses.textEnEsv: and sent them to Iddo, the leading man at the place Casiphia, telling them what to say to Iddo and his brothers and the temple servants at the place Casiphia, namely, to send us ministers for the house of our God.
