verses.textEnNkjv: And I gave them a command for Iddo the chief man at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say to Iddo and his brethren the Nethinim at the place Casiphia—that they should bring us servants for the house of our God.
verses.textEnNlt: I sent them to Iddo, the leader of the Levites at Casiphia, to ask him and his relatives and the Temple servants to send us ministers for the Temple of God at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: And I sent them to Iddo the leading man at the place called Casiphia; and I told them what to say to Iddo and his brothers, the temple servants at the place Casiphia, that is, to bring ministers to us for the house of our God.
verses.textEn: and I ordered them to go to Iddo, the leader in Kasiphia. I told them what to say to Iddo and his fellow Levites, the temple servants in Kasiphia, so that they might bring attendants to us for the house of our God.

verses.textZh: 因为我们神施恩的手帮助我们，他们就从以色列的曾孙、利未的孙子、抹利的子孙中带一个敏悟的人到我们这里来；还有示利比和他的儿子，以及他们的兄弟，共十八人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们神施恩的手帮助我们，他们就从以色列的曾孙、利未的孙子、抹利的子孙中带一个敏悟的人到我们这里来；还有示利比和他的儿子，以及他们的兄弟，共十八人。
verses.textZhCuv: 蒙我们神施恩的手帮助我们，他们在以色列的曾孙、利未的孙子、抹利的后裔中带一个通达人来；还有示利比和他的众子与弟兄共一十八人。
verses.textEnNiv: Because the gracious hand of our God was on us, they brought us Sherebiah, a capable man, from the descendants of Mahli son of Levi, the son of Israel, and Sherebiah’s sons and brothers, 18 in all;
verses.textEnEsv: And by the good hand of our God on us, they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli the son of Levi, son of Israel, namely Sherebiah with his sons and kinsmen, 18;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, by the good hand of our God upon us, they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli the son of Levi, the son of Israel, namely Sherebiah, with his sons and brothers, eighteen men;
verses.textEnNlt: Since the gracious hand of our God was on us, they sent us a man named Sherebiah, along with eighteen of his sons and brothers. He was a very astute man and a descendant of Mahli, who was a descendant of Levi son of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And as the good hand of our God was upon us, they brought us a man of insight from the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel, namely Sherebiah, and his sons and brothers, eighteen men;
verses.textEn: Because the gracious hand of our God was on us, they brought us Sherebiah, a capable man, from the descendants of Mahli son of Levi, the son of Israel, and Sherebiah’s sons and brothers, 18 in all;

verses.textZh: 又有哈沙比雅和与他在一起的米拉利的子孙耶筛亚，以及他的兄弟和他们的儿子共二十人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有哈沙比雅和与他在一起的米拉利的子孙耶筛亚，以及他的兄弟和他们的儿子共二十人。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有哈沙比雅，同着他有米拉利的子孙耶筛亚，并他的众子和弟兄共二十人。
verses.textEnNiv: and Hashabiah, together with Jeshaiah from the descendants of Merari, and his brothers and nephews, 20 in all.
verses.textEnEsv: also Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, with his kinsmen and their sons, 20;
verses.textEnNkjv: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty men;
verses.textEnNlt: They also sent Hashabiah, together with Jeshaiah from the descendants of Merari, and twenty of his sons and brothers,
verses.textEnNasb: and Hashabiah and Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, with his brothers and their sons, twenty men;
verses.textEn: and Hashabiah, together with Jeshaiah from the descendants of Merari, and his brothers and nephews, 20 in all.

verses.textZh: 还有从前大卫和众领袖分派去服事利未人的殿役中，带来了二百二十人，全都是按名呼召的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有从前大卫和众领袖分派去服事利未人的殿役中，带来了二百二十人，全都是按名呼召的。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前大卫和众首领派尼提宁服事利未人，现在从这尼提宁中也带了二百二十人来，都是按名指定的。
verses.textEnNiv: They also brought 220 of the temple servants—a body that David and the officials had established to assist the Levites. All were registered by name.
verses.textEnEsv: besides 220 of the temple servants, whom David and his officials had set apart to attend the Levites. These were all mentioned by name.
verses.textEnNkjv: also of the Nethinim, whom David and the leaders had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinim. All of them were designated by name.
verses.textEnNlt: and 220 Temple servants. The Temple servants were assistants to the Levites—a group of Temple workers first instituted by King David and his officials. They were all listed by name.
verses.textEnNasb: and 220 of the temple servants, whom David and the officials had provided for the service of the Levites, all of them designated by name.
verses.textEn: They also brought 220 of the temple servants—a body that David and the officials had established to assist the Levites. All were registered by name.

verses.textZh: "那时，我在亚哈瓦河边那里宣告禁食，为要在我们的神面前谦卑下来，为自己和我们的孩子，以及我们所有的财物寻求神指示一条畅通的道路。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时，我在亚哈瓦河边那里宣告禁食，为要在我们的神面前谦卑下来，为自己和我们的孩子，以及我们所有的财物寻求神指示一条畅通的道路。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我在亚哈瓦河边宣告禁食，为要在我们神面前克苦己心，求他使我们和妇人孩子，并一切所有的，都得平坦的道路。
verses.textEnNiv: There, by the Ahava Canal, I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a safe journey for ourselves, our children, and all our goods.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river of Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from Him the right way for us and our little ones and all our possessions.
verses.textEnNlt: And there by the Ahava Canal, I gave orders for all of us to fast and humble ourselves before our God. We prayed that he would give us a safe journey and protect us, our children, and our goods as we traveled.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river of Ahava, to humble ourselves before our God, to seek from Him a safe journey for us, our little ones, and all our possessions.
verses.textEn: There, by the Ahava Canal, I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.

verses.textZh: 我羞于请求王派遣步兵和马兵帮助我们抵御路上的仇敌，因为我们曾告诉王说：‘我们神的手必帮助所有寻求他的人，赐福给他们，但他的能力和忿怒必攻击所有离弃他的人。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我羞于请求王派遣步兵和马兵帮助我们抵御路上的仇敌，因为我们曾告诉王说：‘我们神的手必帮助所有寻求他的人，赐福给他们，但他的能力和忿怒必攻击所有离弃他的人。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我求王拨步兵马兵帮助我们抵挡路上的仇敌，本以为羞耻；因我曾对王说：「我们神施恩的手必帮助一切寻求他的；但他的能力和忿怒必攻击一切离弃他的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I was ashamed to ask the king for soldiers and horsemen to protect us from enemies on the road, because we had told the king, "The gracious hand of our God is on everyone who looks to him, but his great anger is against all who forsake him."
verses.textEnEsv: For I was ashamed to ask the king for a band of soldiers and horsemen to protect us against the enemy on our way, since we had told the king, "The hand of our God is for good on all who seek him, and the power of his wrath is against all who forsake him."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I was ashamed to request of the king an escort of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the road, because we had spoken to the king, saying, "The hand of our God is upon all those for good who seek Him, but His power and His wrath are against all those who forsake Him."
verses.textEnNlt: For I was ashamed to ask the king for soldiers and horsemen to accompany us and protect us from enemies along the way. After all, we had told the king, "Our God’s hand of protection is on all who worship him, but his fierce anger rages against those who abandon him."
verses.textEnNasb: For I was ashamed to request from the king troops and horsemen to protect us from the enemy on the way, because we had said to the king, "The hand of our God is favorably disposed to all who seek Him, but His power and His anger are against all those who abandon Him."
verses.textEn: I was ashamed to ask the king for soldiers and horsemen to protect us from enemies on the road, because we had told the king, "The gracious hand of our God is on everyone who looks to him, but his great anger is against all who forsake him."

verses.textZh: 所以我们禁食，寻求我们的神，他就应允我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我们禁食，寻求我们的神，他就应允我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我们禁食祈求我们的神，他就应允了我们。
verses.textEnNiv: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and he answered our prayer.
verses.textEnEsv: So we fasted and implored our God for this, and he listened to our entreaty.
verses.textEnNkjv: So we fasted and entreated our God for this, and He answered our prayer.
verses.textEnNlt: So we fasted and earnestly prayed that our God would take care of us, and he heard our prayer.
verses.textEnNasb: So we fasted and sought our God concerning this matter, and He listened to our pleading.
verses.textEn: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and he answered our prayer.

verses.textZh: "我从祭司首领中选派了十二人，以及示利比、哈沙比雅和与他们在一起的十位兄弟，
verses.textZhCnvs: "我从祭司首领中选派了十二人，以及示利比、哈沙比雅和与他们在一起的十位兄弟，
verses.textZhCuv: 我分派祭司长十二人，就是示利比、哈沙比雅，和他们的弟兄十人，
verses.textEnNiv: Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests, namely, Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their brothers,
verses.textEnEsv: Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests: Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their kinsmen with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I separated twelve of the leaders of the priests—Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them—
verses.textEnNlt: I appointed twelve leaders of the priests—Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten other priests—
verses.textEnNasb: Then I selected twelve of the leading priests: Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and with them ten of their brothers;
verses.textEn: Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests, namely, Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their brothers,

verses.textZh: 把金子、银子和器皿，就是王和他的谋士、领袖，以及在那里的以色列众人献给我们神殿的礼物，都称了交给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把金子、银子和器皿，就是王和他的谋士、领袖，以及在那里的以色列众人献给我们神殿的礼物，都称了交给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 将王和谋士、军长，并在那里的以色列众人为我们神殿所献的金银和器皿，都秤了交给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: and I weighed out to them the offering of silver and gold and the articles that the king, his advisers, his officials and all Israel present there had donated for the house of our God.
verses.textEnEsv: And I weighed out to them the silver and the gold and the vessels, the offering for the house of our God that the king and his counselors and his lords and all Israel there present had offered.
verses.textEnNkjv: and weighed out to them the silver, the gold, and the articles, the offering for the house of our God which the king and his counselors and his princes, and all Israel whowere present, had offered.
verses.textEnNlt: to be in charge of transporting the silver, the gold, the gold bowls, and the other items that the king, his council, his officials, and all the people of Israel had presented for the Temple of God.
verses.textEnNasb: and I weighed out to them the silver, the gold, and the utensils, the offering for the house of our God which the king, his counselors, his officials, and all Israel who were present there had contributed.
verses.textEn: and I weighed out to them the offering of silver and gold and the articles that the king, his advisers, his officials and all Israel present there had donated for the house of our God.

verses.textZh: 我称了交在他们手中的银子，有二十二公吨，银器重三千四百公斤、金子三千四百公斤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我称了交在他们手中的银子，有二十二公吨，银器重三千四百公斤、金子三千四百公斤。
verses.textZhCuv: 我秤了交在他们手中的银子有六百五十他连得；银器重一百他连得；金子一百他连得；
verses.textEnNiv: I weighed out to them 650 talents of silver, silver articles weighing 100 talents, 100 talents of gold,
verses.textEnEsv: I weighed out into their hand 650 talents of silver, and silver vessels worth 200 talents, and 100 talents of gold,
verses.textEnNkjv: I weighed into their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, silver articles weighing one hundred talents, one hundred talents of gold,
verses.textEnNlt: I weighed the treasure as I gave it to them and found the totals to be as follows: 24 tons of silver, 7,500 pounds of silver articles, 7,500 pounds of gold,
verses.textEnNasb: So I weighed into their hands 650 talents of silver, and silver utensils worth a hundred talents, and a hundred gold talents,
verses.textEn: I weighed out to them 650 talents of silver, silver articles weighing 100 talents, 100 talents of gold,

verses.textZh: 金碗二十个，价值八公斤半；上好而发亮的铜器两个，像黄金那样宝贵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 金碗二十个，价值八公斤半；上好而发亮的铜器两个，像黄金那样宝贵。
verses.textZhCuv: 金碗二十个，重一千达利克；上等光铜的器皿两个，宝贵如金。
verses.textEnNiv: 20 bowls of gold valued at 1,000 darics, and two fine articles of polished bronze, as precious as gold.
verses.textEnEsv: 20 bowls of gold worth 1,000 darics, and two vessels of fine bright bronze as precious as gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: twenty gold basins worth a thousand drachmas, and two vessels of fine polished bronze, precious as gold.
verses.textEnNlt: 20 gold bowls, equal in value to 1,000 gold coins, 2 fine articles of polished bronze, as precious as gold.
verses.textEnNasb: and twenty gold bowls worth a thousand darics, and two utensils of fine shiny bronze, precious as gold.
verses.textEn: 20 bowls of gold valued at 1,000 darics, and two fine articles of polished bronze, as precious as gold.

verses.textZh: "我对他们说：‘你们是归耶和华为圣的，器皿也是神圣的，金银是甘心献给耶和华你们列祖的神的礼物。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我对他们说：‘你们是归耶和华为圣的，器皿也是神圣的，金银是甘心献给耶和华你们列祖的神的礼物。
verses.textZhCuv: 我对他们说：「你们归耶和华为圣，器皿也为圣；金银是甘心献给耶和华－你们列祖之神的。
verses.textEnNiv: I said to them, "You as well as these articles are consecrated to the Lord . The silver and gold are a freewill offering to the Lord , the God of your ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: And I said to them, "You are holy to the Lord , and the vessels are holy, and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering to the Lord , the God of your fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said to them, "You are holy to the Lord; the articles are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering to the Lord God of your fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: And I said to these priests, "You and these treasures have been set apart as holy to the Lord . This silver and gold is a voluntary offering to the Lord , the God of our ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said to them, "You are holy to the Lord, and the utensils are holy; and the silver and the gold are a voluntary offering to the Lord God of your fathers.
verses.textEn: I said to them, "You as well as these articles are consecrated to the Lord . The silver and gold are a freewill offering to the Lord , the God of your ancestors.

verses.textZh: 你们要谨慎看守，直到你们在耶路撒冷耶和华殿的库房里，在祭司长和利未人的领袖，以及以色列人的族长面前，过了秤。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要谨慎看守，直到你们在耶路撒冷耶和华殿的库房里，在祭司长和利未人的领袖，以及以色列人的族长面前，过了秤。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们当警醒看守，直到你们在耶路撒冷耶和华殿的库内，在祭司长和利未族长，并以色列的各族长面前过了秤。」
verses.textEnNiv: Guard them carefully until you weigh them out in the chambers of the house of the Lord in Jerusalem before the leading priests and the Levites and the family heads of Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: Guard them and keep them until you weigh them before the chief priests and the Levites and the heads of fathers’ houses in Israel at Jerusalem, within the chambers of the house of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Watch and keep them until you weigh them before the leaders of the priests and the Levites and heads of the fathers’ houses of Israel in Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Guard these treasures well until you present them to the leading priests, the Levites, and the leaders of Israel, who will weigh them at the storerooms of the Lord ’s Temple in Jerusalem."
verses.textEnNasb: Watch and keep them until you weigh them before the leading priests, the Levites, and the leaders of the fathers’ households of Israel in Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the Lord."
verses.textEn: Guard them carefully until you weigh them out in the chambers of the house of the Lord in Jerusalem before the leading priests and the Levites and the family heads of Israel."

verses.textZh: 于是祭司和利未人把称过了的金银和器皿收下，带到耶路撒冷我们神的殿里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是祭司和利未人把称过了的金银和器皿收下，带到耶路撒冷我们神的殿里。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，祭司、利未人按着分量接受金银和器皿，要带到耶路撒冷我们神的殿里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the priests and Levites received the silver and gold and sacred articles that had been weighed out to be taken to the house of our God in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: So the priests and the Levites took over the weight of the silver and the gold and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem, to the house of our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the priests and the Levites received the silver and the gold and the articles by weight, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.
verses.textEnNlt: So the priests and the Levites accepted the task of transporting these treasures of silver and gold to the Temple of our God in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: So the priests and the Levites accepted the weight of silver and gold and the utensils, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.
verses.textEn: Then the priests and Levites received the silver and gold and sacred articles that had been weighed out to be taken to the house of our God in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: "正月十二日，我们从亚哈瓦河启程，往耶路撒冷去。我们的神的手保佑我们，拯救我们脱离仇敌和在路上埋伏的人的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: "正月十二日，我们从亚哈瓦河启程，往耶路撒冷去。我们的神的手保佑我们，拯救我们脱离仇敌和在路上埋伏的人的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 正月十二日，我们从亚哈瓦河边起行，要往耶路撒冷去。我们神的手保佑我们，救我们脱离仇敌和路上埋伏之人的手。
verses.textEnNiv: On the twelfth day of the first month we set out from the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he protected us from enemies and bandits along the way.
verses.textEnEsv: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and from ambushes by the way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem. And the hand of our God was upon us, and He delivered us from the hand of the enemy and from ambush along the road.
verses.textEnNlt: We broke camp at the Ahava Canal on April 19 and started off to Jerusalem. And the gracious hand of our God protected us and saved us from enemies and bandits along the way.
verses.textEnNasb: Then we journeyed from the river Ahava on the twelfth of the first month to go to Jerusalem; and the hand of our God was upon us, and He rescued us from the hand of the enemy and the ambushes by the road.
verses.textEn: On the twelfth day of the first month we set out from the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he protected us from enemies and bandits along the way.

verses.textZh: 我们到了耶路撒冷，在那里住了三天；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们到了耶路撒冷，在那里住了三天；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们到了耶路撒冷，在那里住了三日。
verses.textEnNiv: So we arrived in Jerusalem, where we rested three days.
verses.textEnEsv: We came to Jerusalem, and there we remained three days.
verses.textEnNkjv: So we came to Jerusalem, and stayed there three days.
verses.textEnNlt: So we arrived safely in Jerusalem, where we rested for three days.
verses.textEnNasb: So we came to Jerusalem and remained there for three days.
verses.textEn: So we arrived in Jerusalem, where we rested three days.

verses.textZh: 第四天，在我们神的殿里，金银和器皿都过了秤，交在乌利亚祭司的儿子米利末的手中；与他在一起的有非尼哈的儿子以利亚撒；与他们在一起的还有利未人耶书亚的儿子约撒拔和宾内的儿子挪亚底。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第四天，在我们神的殿里，金银和器皿都过了秤，交在乌利亚祭司的儿子米利末的手中；与他在一起的有非尼哈的儿子以利亚撒；与他们在一起的还有利未人耶书亚的儿子约撒拔和宾内的儿子挪亚底。
verses.textZhCuv: 第四日，在我们神的殿里把金银和器皿都秤了，交在祭司乌利亚的儿子米利末的手中。同着他有非尼哈的儿子以利亚撒，还有利未人耶书亚的儿子约撒拔和宾内的儿子挪亚底。
verses.textEnNiv: On the fourth day, in the house of our God, we weighed out the silver and gold and the sacred articles into the hands of Meremoth son of Uriah, the priest. Eleazar son of Phinehas was with him, and so were the Levites Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
verses.textEnEsv: On the fourth day, within the house of our God, the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed into the hands of Meremoth the priest, son of Uriah, and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas, and with them were the Levites, Jozabad the son of Jeshua and Noadiah the son of Binnui.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now on the fourth day the silver and the gold and the articles were weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest, and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; with them were the Levites, Jozabad the son of Jeshua and Noadiah the son of Binnui,
verses.textEnNlt: On the fourth day after our arrival, the silver, gold, and other valuables were weighed at the Temple of our God and entrusted to Meremoth son of Uriah the priest and to Eleazar son of Phinehas, along with Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui—both of whom were Levites.
verses.textEnNasb: And on the fourth day the silver, the gold, and the utensils were weighed out in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest, and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them were the Levites, Jozabad the son of Jeshua and Noadiah the son of Binnui.
verses.textEn: On the fourth day, in the house of our God, we weighed out the silver and gold and the sacred articles into the hands of Meremoth son of Uriah, the priest. Eleazar son of Phinehas was with him, and so were the Levites Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.

verses.textZh: 一切物品按着数目称过；同时每件的重量都记录下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一切物品按着数目称过；同时每件的重量都记录下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时都点了数目，按着分量写在册上。
verses.textEnNiv: Everything was accounted for by number and weight, and the entire weight was recorded at that time.
verses.textEnEsv: The whole was counted and weighed, and the weight of everything was recorded.
verses.textEnNkjv: with the number and weight of everything. All the weight was written down at that time.
verses.textEnNlt: Everything was accounted for by number and weight, and the total weight was officially recorded.
verses.textEnNasb: A notation was made for everything by number and weight, and all the weight was recorded at that time.
verses.textEn: Everything was accounted for by number and weight, and the entire weight was recorded at that time.

verses.textZh: "那时，从被掳归回的人都向以色列的神献燔祭，就是为全以色列献公牛十二头、公绵羊九十六只、绵羊羔七十七只；又献公山羊十二只作赎罪祭；这一切都是献给耶和华的燔祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时，从被掳归回的人都向以色列的神献燔祭，就是为全以色列献公牛十二头、公绵羊九十六只、绵羊羔七十七只；又献公山羊十二只作赎罪祭；这一切都是献给耶和华的燔祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 从掳到之地归回的人向以色列的神献燔祭，就是为以色列众人献公牛十二只，公绵羊九十六只，绵羊羔七十七只，又献公山羊十二只作赎罪祭，这都是向耶和华焚献的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the exiles who had returned from captivity sacrificed burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven male lambs and, as a sin offering, twelve male goats. All this was a burnt offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: At that time those who had come from captivity, the returned exiles, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel, twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and as a sin offering twelve male goats. All this was a burnt offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The children of those who had been carried away captive, who had come from the captivity, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and twelve male goats as a sin offering. All thiswas a burnt offering to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the exiles who had come out of captivity sacrificed burnt offerings to the God of Israel. They presented twelve bulls for all the people of Israel, as well as ninety-six rams and seventy-seven male lambs. They also offered twelve male goats as a sin offering. All this was given as a burnt offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The exiles who had come from the captivity offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, twelve male goats for a sin offering, all as a burnt offering to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then the exiles who had returned from captivity sacrificed burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven male lambs and, as a sin offering, twelve male goats. All this was a burnt offering to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们把王的命令交给王的总督和河西那边的省长，他们就帮助民众和神殿的需要。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把王的命令交给王的总督和河西那边的省长，他们就帮助民众和神殿的需要。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们将王的谕旨交给王所派的总督与河西的省长，他们就帮助百姓，又供给神殿里所需用的。
verses.textEnNiv: They also delivered the king’s orders to the royal satraps and to the governors of Trans-Euphrates, who then gave assistance to the people and to the house of God.
verses.textEnEsv: They also delivered the king’s commissions to the king’s satraps and to the governors of the province Beyond the River, and they aided the people and the house of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they delivered the king’s orders to the king’s satraps and the governors intheregion beyond the River. So they gave support to the people and the house of God.
verses.textEnNlt: The king’s decrees were delivered to his highest officers and the governors of the province west of the Euphrates River, who then cooperated by supporting the people and the Temple of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they delivered the king’s edicts to the king’s satraps and the governors in the provinces beyond the Euphrates River, and they supported the people and the house of God.
verses.textEn: They also delivered the king’s orders to the royal satraps and to the governors of Trans-Euphrates, who then gave assistance to the people and to the house of God.

verses.textZh: "完成这些事以后，众领袖前来见我，说：‘以色列民、祭司和利未人没有从当地的民族中分别出来，他们随从迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、耶布斯人、亚扪人、摩押人、埃及人和亚摩利人行可憎的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: "完成这些事以后，众领袖前来见我，说：‘以色列民、祭司和利未人没有从当地的民族中分别出来，他们随从迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、耶布斯人、亚扪人、摩押人、埃及人和亚摩利人行可憎的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事做完了，众首领来见我，说：「以色列民和祭司并利未人，没有离绝迦南人、赫人、比利洗人、耶布斯人、亚扪人、摩押人、埃及人、亚摩利人，仍效法这些国的民，行可憎的事。
verses.textEnNiv: After these things had been done, the leaders came to me and said, "The people of Israel, including the priests and the Levites, have not kept themselves separate from the neighboring peoples with their detestable practices, like those of the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians and Amorites.
verses.textEnEsv: After these things had been done, the officials approached me and said, "The people of Israel and the priests and the Levites have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands with their abominations, from the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
verses.textEnNkjv: When these things were done, the leaders came to me, saying, "The people of Israel and the priests and the Levites have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands, with respect to the abominations of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
verses.textEnNlt: When these things had been done, the Jewish leaders came to me and said, "Many of the people of Israel, and even some of the priests and Levites, have not kept themselves separate from the other peoples living in the land. They have taken up the detestable practices of the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians, and Amorites.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when these things had been completed, the officials approached me, saying, "The people of Israel and the priests and the Levites have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands, as to their abominations, those of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
verses.textEn: After these things had been done, the leaders came to me and said, "The people of Israel, including the priests and the Levites, have not kept themselves separate from the neighboring peoples with their detestable practices, like those of the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians and Amorites.

verses.textZh: 他们为自己和自己的儿子娶了这些外族的女子为妻，以致圣洁的种族与当地的民族混杂了；而领袖和官长竟是这不忠的事的罪魁。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们为自己和自己的儿子娶了这些外族的女子为妻，以致圣洁的种族与当地的民族混杂了；而领袖和官长竟是这不忠的事的罪魁。’
verses.textZhCuv: 因他们为自己和儿子娶了这些外邦女子为妻，以致圣洁的种类和这些国的民混杂；而且首领和官长在这事上为罪魁。」
verses.textEnNiv: They have taken some of their daughters as wives for themselves and their sons, and have mingled the holy race with the peoples around them. And the leaders and officials have led the way in this unfaithfulness."
verses.textEnEsv: For they have taken some of their daughters to be wives for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy race has mixed itself with the peoples of the lands. And in this faithlessness the hand of the officials and chief men has been foremost."
verses.textEnNkjv: For they have taken some of their daughters aswives for themselves and their sons, so that the holy seed is mixed with the peoples of those lands. Indeed, the hand of the leaders and rulers has been foremost in this trespass."
verses.textEnNlt: For the men of Israel have married women from these people and have taken them as wives for their sons. So the holy race has become polluted by these mixed marriages. Worse yet, the leaders and officials have led the way in this outrage."
verses.textEnNasb: For they have taken some of their daughters as wives for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy line has intermingled with the peoples of the lands; indeed, the hands of the officials and the leaders have taken the lead in this unfaithfulness."
verses.textEn: They have taken some of their daughters as wives for themselves and their sons, and have mingled the holy race with the peoples around them. And the leaders and officials have led the way in this unfaithfulness."

verses.textZh: 我一听见这事，就撕裂我的衣服和外袍，拔掉头上的头发和胡须，惊惧地坐着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我一听见这事，就撕裂我的衣服和外袍，拔掉头上的头发和胡须，惊惧地坐着。
verses.textZhCuv: 我一听见这事，就撕裂衣服和外袍，拔了头发和胡须，惊惧忧闷而坐。
verses.textEnNiv: When I heard this, I tore my tunic and cloak, pulled hair from my head and beard and sat down appalled.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as I heard this, I tore my garment and my cloak and pulled hair from my head and beard and sat appalled.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my robe, and plucked out some of the hair of my head and beard, and sat down astonished.
verses.textEnNlt: When I heard this, I tore my cloak and my shirt, pulled hair from my head and beard, and sat down utterly shocked.
verses.textEnNasb: When I heard about this matter, I tore my garment and my robe, and pulled out some of the hair from my head and my beard, and sat down appalled.
verses.textEn: When I heard this, I tore my tunic and cloak, pulled hair from my head and beard and sat down appalled.

verses.textZh: 所有因着以色列神针对被掳归回的人之不忠、对他们所说的话而战兢的人，都聚集到我面前。我惊惧地坐着，直到献晚祭的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有因着以色列神针对被掳归回的人之不忠、对他们所说的话而战兢的人，都聚集到我面前。我惊惧地坐着，直到献晚祭的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡为以色列神言语战兢的，都因这被掳归回之人所犯的罪聚集到我这里来。我就惊惧忧闷而坐，直到献晚祭的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel gathered around me because of this unfaithfulness of the exiles. And I sat there appalled until the evening sacrifice.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all who trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the faithlessness of the returned exiles, gathered around me while I sat appalled until the evening sacrifice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel assembled to me, because of the transgression of those who had been carried away captive, and I sat astonished until the evening sacrifice.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all who trembled at the words of the God of Israel came and sat with me because of this outrage committed by the returned exiles. And I sat there utterly appalled until the time of the evening sacrifice.
verses.textEnNasb: Then everyone who was frightened by the words of the God of Israel on account of the unfaithfulness of the exiles gathered to me, and I sat appalled until the evening offering.
verses.textEn: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel gathered around me because of this unfaithfulness of the exiles. And I sat there appalled until the evening sacrifice.

verses.textZh: "献晚祭的时候，我在禁食中起来，穿著撕裂了的衣服和外袍，双膝跪下，向耶和华我的神张开双手，
verses.textZhCnvs: "献晚祭的时候，我在禁食中起来，穿著撕裂了的衣服和外袍，双膝跪下，向耶和华我的神张开双手，
verses.textZhCuv: 献晚祭的时候我起来，心中愁苦，穿着撕裂的衣袍，双膝跪下向耶和华－我的神举手，
verses.textEnNiv: Then, at the evening sacrifice, I rose from my self-abasement, with my tunic and cloak torn, and fell on my knees with my hands spread out to the Lord my God
verses.textEnEsv: And at the evening sacrifice I rose from my fasting, with my garment and my cloak torn, and fell upon my knees and spread out my hands to the Lord my God,
verses.textEnNkjv: At the evening sacrifice I arose from my fasting; and having torn my garment and my robe, I fell on my knees and spread out my hands to the Lord my God.
verses.textEnNlt: At the time of the sacrifice, I stood up from where I had sat in mourning with my clothes torn. I fell to my knees and lifted my hands to the Lord my God.
verses.textEnNasb: But at the evening offering I stood up from my humiliation, even with my garment and my robe torn, and I bowed down on my knees and spread out my hands to the Lord my God;
verses.textEn: Then, at the evening sacrifice, I rose from my self-abasement, with my tunic and cloak torn, and fell on my knees with my hands spread out to the Lord my God

verses.textZh: 祷告说：‘我的神啊，我感觉羞耻惭愧，不敢向我的神你仰面；因为我们的罪孽多至灭顶，我们的罪过滔天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祷告说：‘我的神啊，我感觉羞耻惭愧，不敢向我的神你仰面；因为我们的罪孽多至灭顶，我们的罪过滔天。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「我的神啊，我抱愧蒙羞，不敢向我神仰面；因为我们的罪孽灭顶，我们的罪恶滔天。
verses.textEnNiv: and prayed: "I am too ashamed and disgraced, my God, to lift up my face to you, because our sins are higher than our heads and our guilt has reached to the heavens.
verses.textEnEsv: saying: "O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift my face to you, my God, for our iniquities have risen higher than our heads, and our guilt has mounted up to the heavens.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said: "O my God, I am too ashamed and humiliated to lift up my face to You, my God; for our iniquities have risen higher than our heads, and our guilt has grown up to the heavens.
verses.textEnNlt: I prayed, "O my God, I am utterly ashamed; I blush to lift up my face to you. For our sins are piled higher than our heads, and our guilt has reached to the heavens.
verses.textEnNasb: and I said, "My God, I am ashamed and humiliated to lift up my face to You, my God, for our wrongful deeds have risen above our heads, and our guilt has grown even to the heavens.
verses.textEn: and prayed: "I am too ashamed and disgraced, my God, to lift up my face to you, because our sins are higher than our heads and our guilt has reached to the heavens.

verses.textZh: 从我们列祖的日子直到今日，我们罪恶深重，由于我们的罪孽，我们和我们的王，以及祭司，都被交在各地的列王手中：被刀杀、被掳掠、被抢夺，丢脸蒙羞，就像今天的光景一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从我们列祖的日子直到今日，我们罪恶深重，由于我们的罪孽，我们和我们的王，以及祭司，都被交在各地的列王手中：被刀杀、被掳掠、被抢夺，丢脸蒙羞，就像今天的光景一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 从我们列祖直到今日，我们的罪恶甚重；因我们的罪孽，我们和君王、祭司都交在外邦列王的手中，杀害、掳掠、抢夺、脸上蒙羞正如今日的光景。
verses.textEnNiv: From the days of our ancestors until now, our guilt has been great. Because of our sins, we and our kings and our priests have been subjected to the sword and captivity, to pillage and humiliation at the hand of foreign kings, as it is today.
verses.textEnEsv: From the days of our fathers to this day we have been in great guilt. And for our iniquities we, our kings, and our priests have been given into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plundering, and to utter shame, as it is today.
verses.textEnNkjv: Since the days of our fathers to this day we havebeen very guilty, and for our iniquities we, our kings, and our priests have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plunder, and to humiliation, as itis this day.
verses.textEnNlt: From the days of our ancestors until now, we have been steeped in sin. That is why we and our kings and our priests have been at the mercy of the pagan kings of the land. We have been killed, captured, robbed, and disgraced, just as we are today.
verses.textEnNasb: Since the days of our fathers to this day we have been in great guilt, and because of our wrongful deeds we, our kings, and our priests have been handed over to the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plunder, and to open shame, as it is this day.
verses.textEn: From the days of our ancestors until now, our guilt has been great. Because of our sins, we and our kings and our priests have been subjected to the sword and captivity, to pillage and humiliation at the hand of foreign kings, as it is today.

verses.textZh: 现在，耶和华我们的神恩待我们片时，给我们存留一些逃脱的人，使我们像钉子钉在他的圣所那样的安稳，让我们的神光照我们的眼睛，使我们在所受的奴役中稍得复兴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，耶和华我们的神恩待我们片时，给我们存留一些逃脱的人，使我们像钉子钉在他的圣所那样的安稳，让我们的神光照我们的眼睛，使我们在所受的奴役中稍得复兴。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在耶和华－我们的神暂且施恩与我们，给我们留些逃脱的人，使我们安稳如钉子钉在他的圣所，我们的神好光照我们的眼目，使我们在受辖制之中稍微复兴。
verses.textEnNiv: "But now, for a brief moment, the Lord our God has been gracious in leaving us a remnant and giving us a firm place in his sanctuary, and so our God gives light to our eyes and a little relief in our bondage.
verses.textEnEsv: But now for a brief moment favor has been shown by the Lord our God, to leave us a remnant and to give us a secure hold within his holy place, that our God may brighten our eyes and grant us a little reviving in our slavery.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now for a little while grace has been shown from the Lord our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a peg in His holy place, that our God may enlighten our eyes and give us a measure of revival in our bondage.
verses.textEnNlt: "But now we have been given a brief moment of grace, for the Lord our God has allowed a few of us to survive as a remnant. He has given us security in this holy place. Our God has brightened our eyes and granted us some relief from our slavery.
verses.textEnNasb: But now for a brief moment grace has been shown from the Lord our God, to leave us an escaped remnant and to give us a peg in His holy place, so that our God may enlighten our eyes and grant us a little reviving in our bondage.
verses.textEn: "But now, for a brief moment, the Lord our God has been gracious in leaving us a remnant and giving us a firm place in his sanctuary, and so our God gives light to our eyes and a little relief in our bondage.

verses.textZh: 虽然我们是奴隶，但在奴役中，我们的神仍然没有撇弃我们，反而使我们在波斯列王面前得蒙恩惠，使我们复兴，建立我们神的殿，重修毁坏的地方，使我们在犹大和耶路撒冷有墙垣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然我们是奴隶，但在奴役中，我们的神仍然没有撇弃我们，反而使我们在波斯列王面前得蒙恩惠，使我们复兴，建立我们神的殿，重修毁坏的地方，使我们在犹大和耶路撒冷有墙垣。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们是奴仆，然而在受辖制之中，我们的神仍没有丢弃我们，在波斯王眼前向我们施恩，叫我们复兴，能重建我们神的殿，修其毁坏之处，使我们在犹大和耶路撒冷有墙垣。
verses.textEnNiv: Though we are slaves, our God has not forsaken us in our bondage. He has shown us kindness in the sight of the kings of Persia: He has granted us new life to rebuild the house of our God and repair its ruins, and he has given us a wall of protection in Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: For we are slaves. Yet our God has not forsaken us in our slavery, but has extended to us his steadfast love before the kings of Persia, to grant us some reviving to set up the house of our God, to repair its ruins, and to give us protection in Judea and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we were slaves. Yet our God did not forsake us in our bondage; but He extended mercy to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to revive us, to repair the house of our God, to rebuild its ruins, and to give us a wall in Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: For we were slaves, but in his unfailing love our God did not abandon us in our slavery. Instead, he caused the kings of Persia to treat us favorably. He revived us so we could rebuild the Temple of our God and repair its ruins. He has given us a protective wall in Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: For we are slaves; yet in our bondage our God has not abandoned us, but has extended favor to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us reviving to erect the house of our God, to restore its ruins, and to give us a wall in Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Though we are slaves, our God has not forsaken us in our bondage. He has shown us kindness in the sight of the kings of Persia: He has granted us new life to rebuild the house of our God and repair its ruins, and he has given us a wall of protection in Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 我们的神啊，现在，我们还可以说甚么呢？只能说：我们又离弃了你的诫命，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们的神啊，现在，我们还可以说甚么呢？只能说：我们又离弃了你的诫命，
verses.textZhCuv: 「我们的神啊，既是如此，我们还有什么话可说呢？因为我们已经离弃你的命令，
verses.textEnNiv: "But now, our God, what can we say after this? For we have forsaken the commands
verses.textEnEsv: "And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken your commandments,
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken Your commandments,
verses.textEnNlt: "And now, O our God, what can we say after all of this? For once again we have abandoned your commands!
verses.textEnNasb: "And now, our God, what shall we say after this? For we have abandoned Your commandments,
verses.textEn: "But now, our God, what can we say after this? For we have forsaken the commands

verses.textZh: 就是你曾借着你的仆人众先知所吩咐的。你说：你们进去要得为业之地是污秽的，充满了当地民族的污秽，他们可憎的事使这地从这边到那边都充满了他们的不洁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是你曾借着你的仆人众先知所吩咐的。你说：你们进去要得为业之地是污秽的，充满了当地民族的污秽，他们可憎的事使这地从这边到那边都充满了他们的不洁。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是你藉你仆人众先知所吩咐的说：『你们要去得为业之地是污秽之地；因列国之民的污秽和可憎的事，叫全地从这边直到那边满了污秽。
verses.textEnNiv: you gave through your servants the prophets when you said: ‘The land you are entering to possess is a land polluted by the corruption of its peoples. By their detestable practices they have filled it with their impurity from one end to the other.
verses.textEnEsv: which you commanded by your servants the prophets, saying, ‘The land that you are entering, to take possession of it, is a land impure with the impurity of the peoples of the lands, with their abominations that have filled it from end to end with their uncleanness.
verses.textEnNkjv: which You commanded by Your servants the prophets, saying, ‘The land which you are entering to possess is an unclean land, with the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands, with their abominations which have filled it from one end to another with their impurity.
verses.textEnNlt: Your servants the prophets warned us when they said, ‘The land you are entering to possess is totally defiled by the detestable practices of the people living there. From one end to the other, the land is filled with corruption.
verses.textEnNasb: which You have commanded by Your servants the prophets, saying, ‘The land which you are entering to possess is an unclean land with the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands, with their abominations which have filled it from end to end, and with their impurity.
verses.textEn: you gave through your servants the prophets when you said: ‘The land you are entering to possess is a land polluted by the corruption of its peoples. By their detestable practices they have filled it with their impurity from one end to the other.

verses.textZh: 所以，你们不可把你们的女儿嫁给他们的儿子，也不可为你们的儿子娶他们的女儿。你们永远不可寻求他们的平安和他们的利益；这样，你们就可以强盛，吃这地的美物，把这地留给你们的子孙作产业，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你们不可把你们的女儿嫁给他们的儿子，也不可为你们的儿子娶他们的女儿。你们永远不可寻求他们的平安和他们的利益；这样，你们就可以强盛，吃这地的美物，把这地留给你们的子孙作产业，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以不可将你们的女儿嫁他们的儿子，也不可为你们的儿子娶他们的女儿，永不可求他们的平安和他们的利益，这样你们就可以强盛，吃这地的美物，并遗留这地给你们的子孙永远为业。』
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, do not give your daughters in marriage to their sons or take their daughters for your sons. Do not seek a treaty of friendship with them at any time, that you may be strong and eat the good things of the land and leave it to your children as an everlasting inheritance.’
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore do not give your daughters to their sons, neither take their daughters for your sons, and never seek their peace or prosperity, that you may be strong and eat the good of the land and leave it for an inheritance to your children forever.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, do not give your daughters as wives for their sons, nor take their daughters to your sons; and never seek their peace or prosperity, that you may be strong and eat the good of the land, and leave it as an inheritance to your children forever.’
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let your daughters marry their sons! Don’t take their daughters as wives for your sons. Don’t ever promote the peace and prosperity of those nations. If you follow these instructions, you will be strong and will enjoy the good things the land produces, and you will leave this prosperity to your children forever.’
verses.textEnNasb: So now do not give your daughters to their sons nor take their daughters for your sons, and never seek their peace or their prosperity, so that you may be strong and may eat the good things of the land, and leave it as an inheritance to your sons forever.’
verses.textEn: Therefore, do not give your daughters in marriage to their sons or take their daughters for your sons. Do not seek a treaty of friendship with them at any time, that you may be strong and eat the good things of the land and leave it to your children as an everlasting inheritance.’

verses.textZh: 虽然因着我们许多的恶行和重大的罪过，这一切就临到我们身上，但我们的神啊，你惩罚我们实在轻于我们的罪孽所应得的，还给我们留下这些逃脱的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然因着我们许多的恶行和重大的罪过，这一切就临到我们身上，但我们的神啊，你惩罚我们实在轻于我们的罪孽所应得的，还给我们留下这些逃脱的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，我们因自己的恶行和大罪，遭遇了这一切的事，并且你刑罚我们轻于我们罪所当得的，又给我们留下这些人。
verses.textEnNiv: "What has happened to us is a result of our evil deeds and our great guilt, and yet, our God, you have punished us less than our sins deserved and have given us a remnant like this.
verses.textEnEsv: And after all that has come upon us for our evil deeds and for our great guilt, seeing that you, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserved and have given us such a remnant as this,
verses.textEnNkjv: And after all that has come upon us for our evil deeds and for our great guilt, since You our God have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and have given us such deliverance as this,
verses.textEnNlt: "Now we are being punished because of our wickedness and our great guilt. But we have actually been punished far less than we deserve, for you, our God, have allowed some of us to survive as a remnant.
verses.textEnNasb: And after everything that has come upon us for our evil deeds and our great guilt, since You our God have spared us by inflicting less than our wrongdoing deserves, and have given us such an escaped remnant as this,
verses.textEn: "What has happened to us is a result of our evil deeds and our great guilt, and yet, our God, you have punished us less than our sins deserved and have given us a remnant like this.

verses.textZh: 我们怎可以再违背你的诫命，与这些行可憎事的民族通婚呢？如果我们这样行，你岂不向我们发怒，消灭我们，以致没有一个剩余，或是逃脱的人吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们怎可以再违背你的诫命，与这些行可憎事的民族通婚呢？如果我们这样行，你岂不向我们发怒，消灭我们，以致没有一个剩余，或是逃脱的人吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们岂可再违背你的命令，与这行可憎之事的民结亲呢？若这样行，你岂不向我们发怒，将我们灭绝，以致没有一个剩下逃脱的人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Shall we then break your commands again and intermarry with the peoples who commit such detestable practices? Would you not be angry enough with us to destroy us, leaving us no remnant or survivor?
verses.textEnEsv: shall we break your commandments again and intermarry with the peoples who practice these abominations? Would you not be angry with us until you consumed us, so that there should be no remnant, nor any to escape?
verses.textEnNkjv: should we again break Your commandments, and join in marriage with the people committing these abominations? Would You not be angry with us until You had consumed us, so that therewouldbe no remnant or survivor?
verses.textEnNlt: But even so, we are again breaking your commands and intermarrying with people who do these detestable things. Won’t your anger be enough to destroy us, so that even this little remnant no longer survives?
verses.textEnNasb: shall we again break Your commandments and intermarry with the peoples who commit these abominations? Would You not be angry with us to the point of destruction, until there would be no remnant nor any who would escape?
verses.textEn: Shall we then break your commands again and intermarry with the peoples who commit such detestable practices? Would you not be angry enough with us to destroy us, leaving us no remnant or survivor?

verses.textZh: 耶和华以色列的神啊，你是公义的！我们现今才可以留下，成为逃脱的人。看哪，我们在你面前是有罪过的，因此没有人能在你面前站立得住。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华以色列的神啊，你是公义的！我们现今才可以留下，成为逃脱的人。看哪，我们在你面前是有罪过的，因此没有人能在你面前站立得住。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的神啊，因你是公义的，我们这剩下的人才得逃脱，正如今日的光景。看哪，我们在你面前有罪恶，因此无人在你面前站立得住。」
verses.textEnNiv: Lord , the God of Israel, you are righteous! We are left this day as a remnant. Here we are before you in our guilt, though because of it not one of us can stand in your presence."
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord , the God of Israel, you are just, for we are left a remnant that has escaped, as it is today. Behold, we are before you in our guilt, for none can stand before you because of this."
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord God of Israel, You are righteous, for we are left as a remnant, as itis this day. Here we are before You, in our guilt, though no one can stand before You because of this!"
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , God of Israel, you are just. We come before you in our guilt as nothing but an escaped remnant, though in such a condition none of us can stand in your presence."
verses.textEnNasb: Lord God of Israel, You are righteous, for we have been left an escaped remnant, as it is this day; behold, we are before You in our guilt, for no one can stand before You because of this."
verses.textEn: Lord , the God of Israel, you are righteous! We are left this day as a remnant. Here we are before you in our guilt, though because of it not one of us can stand in your presence."

verses.textZh: 以斯拉祷告、认罪、哭泣，俯伏在神的殿前的时候，有一大群以色列人，包括男女小孩，在他面前聚集；众人也都痛哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯拉祷告、认罪、哭泣，俯伏在神的殿前的时候，有一大群以色列人，包括男女小孩，在他面前聚集；众人也都痛哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯拉祷告，认罪，哭泣，俯伏在神殿前的时候，有以色列中的男女孩童聚集到以斯拉那里，成了大会，众民无不痛哭。
verses.textEnNiv: While Ezra was praying and confessing, weeping and throwing himself down before the house of God, a large crowd of Israelites—men, women and children—gathered around him. They too wept bitterly.
verses.textEnEsv: While Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, a very great assembly of men, women, and children, gathered to him out of Israel, for the people wept bitterly.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now while Ezra was praying, and while he was confessing, weeping, and bowing down before the house of God, a very large assembly of men, women, and children gathered to him from Israel; for the people wept very bitterly.
verses.textEnNlt: While Ezra prayed and made this confession, weeping and lying face down on the ground in front of the Temple of God, a very large crowd of people from Israel—men, women, and children—gathered and wept bitterly with him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now while Ezra was praying and making confession, weeping and prostrating himself before the house of God, a very large assembly, men, women, and children, gathered to him from Israel; for the people wept greatly.
verses.textEn: While Ezra was praying and confessing, weeping and throwing himself down before the house of God, a large crowd of Israelites—men, women and children—gathered around him. They too wept bitterly.

verses.textZh: 属以拦的子孙、耶歇的儿子示迦尼对以斯拉说："我们对神不忠，娶了这地这外族女子为妻。虽然这样，以色列现在还有希望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属以拦的子孙、耶歇的儿子示迦尼对以斯拉说："我们对神不忠，娶了这地这外族女子为妻。虽然这样，以色列现在还有希望。
verses.textZhCuv: 属以拦的子孙、耶歇的儿子示迦尼对以斯拉说：「我们在此地娶了外邦女子为妻，干犯了我们的神，然而以色列人还有指望。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Shekaniah son of Jehiel, one of the descendants of Elam, said to Ezra, "We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the peoples around us. But in spite of this, there is still hope for Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, of the sons of Elam, addressed Ezra: "We have broken faith with our God and have married foreign women from the peoples of the land, but even now there is hope for Israel in spite of this.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, spoke up and said to Ezra, "We have trespassed against our God, and have taken pagan wives from the peoples of the land; yet now there is hope in Israel in spite of this.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, a descendant of Elam, said to Ezra, "We have been unfaithful to our God, for we have married these pagan women of the land. But in spite of this there is hope for Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, said to Ezra, "We have been unfaithful to our God and have married foreign women from the peoples of the land; yet now there is hope for Israel in spite of this.
verses.textEn: Then Shekaniah son of Jehiel, one of the descendants of Elam, said to Ezra, "We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the peoples around us. But in spite of this, there is still hope for Israel.

verses.textZh: 现在，我们应当与我们的神立约，按着我主和那些因我们神的诫命而战兢的人所议定的，照着律法而行，送走这些妻子和她们所生的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，我们应当与我们的神立约，按着我主和那些因我们神的诫命而战兢的人所议定的，照着律法而行，送走这些妻子和她们所生的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在当与我们的神立约，休这一切的妻，离绝她们所生的，照着我主和那因神命令战兢之人所议定的，按律法而行。
verses.textEnNiv: Now let us make a covenant before our God to send away all these women and their children, in accordance with the counsel of my lord and of those who fear the commands of our God. Let it be done according to the Law.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all these wives and their children, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God, and let it be done according to the Law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, let us make a covenant with our God to put away all these wives and those who have been born to them, according to the advice of my master and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.
verses.textEnNlt: Let us now make a covenant with our God to divorce our pagan wives and to send them away with their children. We will follow the advice given by you and by the others who respect the commands of our God. Let it be done according to the Law of God.
verses.textEnNasb: So now let’s make a covenant with our God to send away all the wives and their children, following the counsel of my lord and of those who fear the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the Law.
verses.textEn: Now let us make a covenant before our God to send away all these women and their children, in accordance with the counsel of my lord and of those who fear the commands of our God. Let it be done according to the Law.

verses.textZh: 你起来！因为这事全在你身上，我们支持你，你当坚强地去作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你起来！因为这事全在你身上，我们支持你，你当坚强地去作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你起来，这是你当办的事，我们必帮助你，你当奋勉而行。」
verses.textEnNiv: Rise up; this matter is in your hands. We will support you, so take courage and do it."
verses.textEnEsv: Arise, for it is your task, and we are with you; be strong and do it."
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise, for this matter is your responsibility. We also are with you. Be of good courage, and do it."
verses.textEnNlt: Get up, for it is your duty to tell us how to proceed in setting things straight. We are behind you, so be strong and take action."
verses.textEnNasb: Arise! For this matter is your responsibility, but we will be with you; be courageous and act."
verses.textEn: Rise up; this matter is in your hands. We will support you, so take courage and do it."

verses.textZh: 于是以斯拉起来，使祭司首领、利未人和以色列众人起誓要照着这话去行；他们就起誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以斯拉起来，使祭司首领、利未人和以色列众人起誓要照着这话去行；他们就起誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯拉便起来，使祭司长和利未人，并以色列众人起誓说，必照这话去行；他们就起了誓。
verses.textEnNiv: So Ezra rose up and put the leading priests and Levites and all Israel under oath to do what had been suggested. And they took the oath.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Ezra arose and made the leading priests and Levites and all Israel take an oath that they would do as had been said. So they took the oath.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ezra arose, and made the leaders of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel swear an oath that they would do according to this word. So they swore an oath.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ezra stood up and demanded that the leaders of the priests and the Levites and all the people of Israel swear that they would do as Shecaniah had said. And they all swore a solemn oath.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ezra stood and made the leading priests, the Levites, and all Israel take an oath that they would do according to this proposal; so they took the oath.
verses.textEn: So Ezra rose up and put the leading priests and Levites and all Israel under oath to do what had been suggested. And they took the oath.

verses.textZh: 以斯拉就从神的殿前起来，走进以利亚实的儿子约哈难的屋里去；他在那里不吃饭，也不喝水，因为他为了被掳归回的人的不忠而悲伤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯拉就从神的殿前起来，走进以利亚实的儿子约哈难的屋里去；他在那里不吃饭，也不喝水，因为他为了被掳归回的人的不忠而悲伤。
verses.textZhCuv: 以斯拉从神殿前起来，进入以利亚实的儿子约哈难的屋里，到了那里不吃饭，也不喝水；因为被掳归回之人所犯的罪，心里悲伤。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Ezra withdrew from before the house of God and went to the room of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. While he was there, he ate no food and drank no water, because he continued to mourn over the unfaithfulness of the exiles.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Ezra withdrew from before the house of God and went to the chamber of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib, where he spent the night, neither eating bread nor drinking water, for he was mourning over the faithlessness of the exiles.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib; and when he came there, he ate no bread and drank no water, for he mourned because of the guilt of those from the captivity.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Ezra left the front of the Temple of God and went to the room of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He spent the night there without eating or drinking anything. He was still in mourning because of the unfaithfulness of the returned exiles.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ezra rose from before the house of God and went into the chamber of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib. Although he went there, he did not eat bread nor drink water, because he was mourning over the unfaithfulness of the exiles.
verses.textEn: Then Ezra withdrew from before the house of God and went to the room of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. While he was there, he ate no food and drank no water, because he continued to mourn over the unfaithfulness of the exiles.

verses.textZh: 于是，领袖们就在犹大和耶路撒冷向所有被掳归回的人发出通告，叫他们到耶路撒冷聚集。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，领袖们就在犹大和耶路撒冷向所有被掳归回的人发出通告，叫他们到耶路撒冷聚集。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们通告犹大和耶路撒冷被掳归回的人，叫他们在耶路撒冷聚集。
verses.textEnNiv: A proclamation was then issued throughout Judah and Jerusalem for all the exiles to assemble in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And a proclamation was made throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the returned exiles that they should assemble at Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNkjv: And they issued a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the descendants of the captivity, that they must gather at Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNlt: Then a proclamation was made throughout Judah and Jerusalem that all the exiles should come to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: So they made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the exiles, that they were to assemble at Jerusalem,
verses.textEn: A proclamation was then issued throughout Judah and Jerusalem for all the exiles to assemble in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 所有不照着众领袖和众长老所议定，在三日之内来到的人，所有的财物都要充公，也要从被掳归回之人的会中被逐出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有不照着众领袖和众长老所议定，在三日之内来到的人，所有的财物都要充公，也要从被掳归回之人的会中被逐出。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡不遵首领和长老所议定、三日之内不来的，就必抄他的家，使他离开被掳归回之人的会。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who failed to appear within three days would forfeit all his property, in accordance with the decision of the officials and elders, and would himself be expelled from the assembly of the exiles.
verses.textEnEsv: and that if anyone did not come within three days, by order of the officials and the elders all his property should be forfeited, and he himself banned from the congregation of the exiles.
verses.textEnNkjv: and that whoever would not come within three days, according to the instructions of the leaders and elders, all his property would be confiscated, and he himself would be separated from the assembly of those from the captivity.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who failed to come within three days would, if the leaders and elders so decided, forfeit all their property and be expelled from the assembly of the exiles.
verses.textEnNasb: and that whoever did not come within three days, in accordance with the counsel of the leaders and the elders, all his property would be forfeited, and he himself would be excluded from the assembly of the exiles.
verses.textEn: Anyone who failed to appear within three days would forfeit all his property, in accordance with the decision of the officials and elders, and would himself be expelled from the assembly of the exiles.

verses.textZh: 于是犹大和便雅悯众人，三日之内都在耶路撒冷聚集，那时是九月二十日，众人坐在神殿的广场上；因为这事，又因为天下大雨的缘故，大家就都战栗发抖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是犹大和便雅悯众人，三日之内都在耶路撒冷聚集，那时是九月二十日，众人坐在神殿的广场上；因为这事，又因为天下大雨的缘故，大家就都战栗发抖。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，犹大和便雅悯众人，三日之内都聚集在耶路撒冷。那日正是九月二十日，众人都坐在神殿前的宽阔处；因这事，又因下大雨，就都战兢。
verses.textEnNiv: Within the three days, all the men of Judah and Benjamin had gathered in Jerusalem. And on the twentieth day of the ninth month, all the people were sitting in the square before the house of God, greatly distressed by the occasion and because of the rain.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled at Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month. And all the people sat in the open square before the house of God, trembling because of this matter and because of the heavy rain.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered at Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth of the month; and all the people sat in the open square of the house of God, trembling because of this matter and because of heavy rain.
verses.textEnNlt: Within three days, all the people of Judah and Benjamin had gathered in Jerusalem. This took place on December 19, and all the people were sitting in the square before the Temple of God. They were trembling both because of the seriousness of the matter and because it was raining.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled at Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month on the twentieth of the month, and all the people sat in the public square before the house of God, trembling because of this matter and the heavy rain.
verses.textEn: Within the three days, all the men of Judah and Benjamin had gathered in Jerusalem. And on the twentieth day of the ninth month, all the people were sitting in the square before the house of God, greatly distressed by the occasion and because of the rain.

verses.textZh: 以斯拉祭司站起来，对他们说："你们对神不忠，娶了外族的女子为妻，增添了以色列的罪过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以斯拉祭司站起来，对他们说："你们对神不忠，娶了外族的女子为妻，增添了以色列的罪过。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司以斯拉站起来，对他们说：「你们有罪了；因你们娶了外邦的女子为妻，增添以色列人的罪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, "You have been unfaithful; you have married foreign women, adding to Israel’s guilt.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, "You have broken faith and married foreign women, and so increased the guilt of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, "You have transgressed and have taken pagan wives, adding to the guilt of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Ezra the priest stood and said to them: "You have committed a terrible sin. By marrying pagan women, you have increased Israel’s guilt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, "You have been unfaithful and have married foreign wives, adding to the guilt of Israel.
verses.textEn: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, "You have been unfaithful; you have married foreign women, adding to Israel’s guilt.

verses.textZh: 现在你们要向耶和华你们列祖的神认罪，遵行他所喜悦的旨意，与这地的民族和外族的女子分离。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们要向耶和华你们列祖的神认罪，遵行他所喜悦的旨意，与这地的民族和外族的女子分离。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在当向耶和华－你们列祖的神认罪，遵行他的旨意，离绝这些国的民和外邦的女子。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now honor the Lord , the God of your ancestors, and do his will. Separate yourselves from the peoples around you and from your foreign wives."
verses.textEnEsv: Now then make confession to the Lord , the God of your fathers and do his will. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign wives."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, make confession to the Lord God of your fathers, and do His will; separate yourselves from the peoples of the land, and from the pagan wives."
verses.textEnNlt: So now confess your sin to the Lord , the God of your ancestors, and do what he demands. Separate yourselves from the people of the land and from these pagan women."
verses.textEnNasb: Now therefore, make confession to the Lord God of your fathers and do His will; and separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign wives."
verses.textEn: Now honor the Lord , the God of your ancestors, and do his will. Separate yourselves from the peoples around you and from your foreign wives."

verses.textZh: 全体会众都大声回答说："你怎么说，我们就怎么行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体会众都大声回答说："你怎么说，我们就怎么行。
verses.textZhCuv: 会众都大声回答说：「我们必照着你的话行，
verses.textEnNiv: The whole assembly responded with a loud voice: "You are right! We must do as you say.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice, "It is so; we must do as you have said.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the assembly answered and said with a loud voice, "Yes! As you have said, so we must do.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the whole assembly raised their voices and answered, "Yes, you are right; we must do as you say!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the assembly replied with a loud voice, "It is our duty to do exactly as you have said!
verses.textEn: The whole assembly responded with a loud voice: "You are right! We must do as you say.

verses.textZh: 可是人太多，又逢下大雨的季节，我们不能停留在外面；这又不是一两天可以完成的事，因为我们很多人在这事上犯了罪！
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是人太多，又逢下大雨的季节，我们不能停留在外面；这又不是一两天可以完成的事，因为我们很多人在这事上犯了罪！
verses.textZhCuv: 只是百姓众多，又逢大雨的时令，我们不能站在外头，这也不是一两天办完的事，因我们在这事上犯了大罪；
verses.textEnNiv: But there are many people here and it is the rainy season; so we cannot stand outside. Besides, this matter cannot be taken care of in a day or two, because we have sinned greatly in this thing.
verses.textEnEsv: But the people are many, and it is a time of heavy rain; we cannot stand in the open. Nor is this a task for one day or for two, for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.
verses.textEnNkjv: But thereare many people; itis the season for heavy rain, and we are not able to stand outside. Nor isthis the work of one or two days, for thereare many of us who have transgressed in this matter.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they added, "This isn’t something that can be done in a day or two, for many of us are involved in this extremely sinful affair. And this is the rainy season, so we cannot stay out here much longer.
verses.textEnNasb: However, there are many people, it is the rainy season, and we are not able to stand in the open. Nor can the task be done in one or two days, because we have done a great wrong in this matter.
verses.textEn: But there are many people here and it is the rainy season; so we cannot stand outside. Besides, this matter cannot be taken care of in a day or two, because we have sinned greatly in this thing.

verses.textZh: 让我们的领袖代表全体会众站在耶和华面前，所有在我们的城中娶了外族女子为妻的人，也都要在指定的日期，与本城的长老和审判官一起来，解决了这事，好使神因这事所发的烈怒离开我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 让我们的领袖代表全体会众站在耶和华面前，所有在我们的城中娶了外族女子为妻的人，也都要在指定的日期，与本城的长老和审判官一起来，解决了这事，好使神因这事所发的烈怒离开我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 不如为全会众派首领办理。凡我们城邑中娶外邦女子为妻的，当按所定的日期，同着本城的长老和士师而来，直到办完这事，神的烈怒就转离我们了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Let our officials act for the whole assembly. Then let everyone in our towns who has married a foreign woman come at a set time, along with the elders and judges of each town, until the fierce anger of our God in this matter is turned away from us."
verses.textEnEsv: Let our officials stand for the whole assembly. Let all in our cities who have taken foreign wives come at appointed times, and with them the elders and judges of every city, until the fierce wrath of our God over this matter is turned away from us."
verses.textEnNkjv: Please, let the leaders of our entire assembly stand; and let all those in our cities who have taken pagan wives come at appointed times, together with the elders and judges of their cities, until the fierce wrath of our God is turned away from us in this matter."
verses.textEnNlt: Let our leaders act on behalf of us all. Let everyone who has a pagan wife come at a scheduled time, accompanied by the leaders and judges of his city, so that the fierce anger of our God concerning this affair may be turned away from us."
verses.textEnNasb: Please let our leaders represent all the assembly and have all those in our cities who have married foreign wives come at appointed times, together with the elders and judges of each city, until the fierce anger of our God on account of this matter is turned away from us."
verses.textEn: Let our officials act for the whole assembly. Then let everyone in our towns who has married a foreign woman come at a set time, along with the elders and judges of each town, until the fierce anger of our God in this matter is turned away from us."

verses.textZh: 只有亚撒黑的儿子约拿单和特瓦的儿子雅哈谢起来反对这提议，还有米书兰和利未人沙比太支持他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有亚撒黑的儿子约拿单和特瓦的儿子雅哈谢起来反对这提议，还有米书兰和利未人沙比太支持他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有亚撒黑的儿子约拿单，特瓦的儿子雅哈谢阻挡 这事，并有米书兰和利未人沙比太帮助他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah, supported by Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite, opposed this.
verses.textEnEsv: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah opposed this, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite supported them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah opposed this, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite gave them support.
verses.textEnNlt: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah opposed this course of action, and they were supported by Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite.
verses.textEnNasb: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah opposed this, with Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite supporting them.
verses.textEn: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah, supported by Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite, opposed this.

verses.textZh: 于是，被掳归回的人就这样行。以斯拉祭司提名选派了一些人，是各宗族的族长，于十月初一他们一同坐下来查办这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，被掳归回的人就这样行。以斯拉祭司提名选派了一些人，是各宗族的族长，于十月初一他们一同坐下来查办这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 被掳归回的人如此而行。祭司以斯拉和些族长按着宗族都指名见派；在十月初一日，一同在座查办这事，
verses.textEnNiv: So the exiles did as was proposed. Ezra the priest selected men who were family heads, one from each family division, and all of them designated by name. On the first day of the tenth month they sat down to investigate the cases,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the returned exiles did so. Ezra the priest selected men, heads of fathers’ houses, according to their fathers’ houses, each of them designated by name. On the first day of the tenth month they sat down to examine the matter;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the descendants of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain heads of the fathers’ households, were set apart by the fathers’ households, each of them by name; and they sat down on the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
verses.textEnNlt: So this was the plan they followed. Ezra selected leaders to represent their families, designating each of the representatives by name. On December 29, the leaders sat down to investigate the matter.
verses.textEnNasb: But the exiles did so. And Ezra the priest selected men who were the heads of fathers’ households for each of their father’s households, all of them by name. So they convened on the first day of the tenth month to investigate the matter.
verses.textEn: So the exiles did as was proposed. Ezra the priest selected men who were family heads, one from each family division, and all of them designated by name. On the first day of the tenth month they sat down to investigate the cases,

verses.textZh: 直到正月初一，他们才完成审查所有娶了外族的女子为妻的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到正月初一，他们才完成审查所有娶了外族的女子为妻的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 到正月初一日，才查清娶外邦女子的人数。
verses.textEnNiv: and by the first day of the first month they finished dealing with all the men who had married foreign women.
verses.textEnEsv: and by the first day of the first month they had come to the end of all the men who had married foreign women.
verses.textEnNkjv: By the first day of the first month they finished questioning all the men who had taken pagan wives.
verses.textEnNlt: By March 27, the first day of the new year, they had finished dealing with all the men who had married pagan wives.
verses.textEnNasb: And they finished investigating all the men who had married foreign wives by the first day of the first month.
verses.textEn: and by the first day of the first month they finished dealing with all the men who had married foreign women.

verses.textZh: 在祭司子孙中，娶了外族的女子为妻的有耶书亚的子孙，约萨达的儿子和他的兄弟玛西雅、以利以谢、雅立、基大利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在祭司子孙中，娶了外族的女子为妻的有耶书亚的子孙，约萨达的儿子和他的兄弟玛西雅、以利以谢、雅立、基大利。
verses.textZhCuv: 在祭司中查出娶外邦女子为妻的，就是耶书亚的子孙约萨达的儿子，和他弟兄玛西雅、以利以谢、雅立、基大利；
verses.textEnNiv: Among the descendants of the priests, the following had married foreign women: From the descendants of Joshua son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib and Gedaliah.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there were found some of the sons of the priests who had married foreign women: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah, some of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak and his brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And among the sons of the priests who had taken pagan wives thefollowing were found of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the priests who had married pagan wives: From the family of Jeshua son of Jehozadak and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now among the sons of the priests who had married foreign wives were found of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.
verses.textEn: Among the descendants of the priests, the following had married foreign women: From the descendants of Joshua son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib and Gedaliah.

verses.textZh: 他们举手起誓要送走他们的妻子，并献赎罪祭。他们就献上一只公绵羊，作他们的赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们举手起誓要送走他们的妻子，并献赎罪祭。他们就献上一只公绵羊，作他们的赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们便应许必休他们的妻。他们因有罪，就献群中的一只公绵羊赎罪。
verses.textEnNiv: (They all gave their hands in pledge to put away their wives, and for their guilt they each presented a ram from the flock as a guilt offering.)
verses.textEnEsv: They pledged themselves to put away their wives, and their guilt offering was a ram of the flock for their guilt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they gave their promise that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, theypresented a ram of the flock as their trespass offering.
verses.textEnNlt: They vowed to divorce their wives, and they each acknowledged their guilt by offering a ram as a guilt offering.
verses.textEnNasb: They pledged to send away their wives, and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.
verses.textEn: (They all gave their hands in pledge to put away their wives, and for their guilt they each presented a ram from the flock as a guilt offering.)

verses.textZh: 音麦的子孙中，有哈拿尼和西巴第雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 音麦的子孙中，有哈拿尼和西巴第雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 音麦的子孙中，有哈拿尼、西巴第雅。
verses.textEnNiv: From the descendants of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah;
verses.textEnNlt: From the family of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Of the sons of Immer, there were Hanani and Zebadiah;
verses.textEn: From the descendants of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

verses.textZh: 哈琳的子孙中，有玛西雅、以利雅、示玛雅、耶歇和乌西雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈琳的子孙中，有玛西雅、以利雅、示玛雅、耶歇和乌西雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈琳的子孙中，有玛西雅、以利雅、示玛雅、耶歇、乌西雅。
verses.textEnNiv: From the descendants of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel and Uzziah.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah;
verses.textEnNlt: From the family of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.
verses.textEnNasb: and of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah;
verses.textEn: From the descendants of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel and Uzziah.

verses.textZh: 巴施户珥的子孙中，有以利约乃、玛西雅、以实玛利、拿坦业、约撒拔和以利亚撒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴施户珥的子孙中，有以利约乃、玛西雅、以实玛利、拿坦业、约撒拔和以利亚撒。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴施户珥的子孙中，有以利约乃、玛西雅、以实玛利、拿坦业、约撒拔、以利亚撒。
verses.textEnNiv: From the descendants of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad and Elasah.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
verses.textEnNlt: From the family of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
verses.textEnNasb: and of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
verses.textEn: From the descendants of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad and Elasah.

verses.textZh: 利未人中有约撒拔、示每、基拉雅 ，还有毘他希雅、犹大和以利以谢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人中有约撒拔、示每、基拉雅 ，还有毘他希雅、犹大和以利以谢。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人中，有约撒拔、示每、基拉雅（基拉雅就是基利他），还有毗他希雅、犹大、以利以谢。
verses.textEnNiv: Among the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (that is, Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah and Eliezer.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (that is, Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (the same is Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the Levites who were guilty: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (also called Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
verses.textEnNasb: Of the Levites there were Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (that is, Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
verses.textEn: Among the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (that is, Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah and Eliezer.

verses.textZh: 歌唱者中，有以利亚实。守门的人中，有沙龙、提联和乌利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌唱者中，有以利亚实。守门的人中，有沙龙、提联和乌利。
verses.textZhCuv: 歌唱的人中有以利亚实。守门的人中，有沙龙、提联、乌利。
verses.textEnNiv: From the musicians: Eliashib. From the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem and Uri.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the singers: Eliashib. Of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also of the singers: Eliashib; and of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the singer who was guilty: Eliashib. These are the gatekeepers who were guilty: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
verses.textEnNasb: Of the singers there was Eliashib; and of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
verses.textEn: From the musicians: Eliashib. From the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem and Uri.

verses.textZh: 属以色列人的巴录的子孙中，有拉米、耶西雅、玛基雅、米雅民、以利亚撒、玛基雅、比拿雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属以色列人的巴录的子孙中，有拉米、耶西雅、玛基雅、米雅民、以利亚撒、玛基雅、比拿雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人巴录的子孙中，有拉米、耶西雅、玛基雅、米雅民、以利亚撒、玛基雅、比拿雅。
verses.textEnNiv: And among the other Israelites: From the descendants of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malkijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malkijah and Benaiah.
verses.textEnEsv: And of Israel: of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And others of Israel: of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Jeziah, Malchiah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah;
verses.textEnNlt: These are the other people of Israel who were guilty: From the family of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malkijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah.
verses.textEnNasb: Of Israel, of the sons of Parosh there were Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah;
verses.textEn: And among the other Israelites: From the descendants of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malkijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malkijah and Benaiah.

verses.textZh: 以拦的子孙中，有玛他尼、撒迦利亚、耶歇、押底、耶利末和以利雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以拦的子孙中，有玛他尼、撒迦利亚、耶歇、押底、耶利末和以利雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 以拦的子孙中，有玛他尼、撒迦利亚、耶歇、押底、耶利末、以利雅。
verses.textEnNiv: From the descendants of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth and Elijah.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Eliah;
verses.textEnNlt: From the family of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.
verses.textEnNasb: and of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah;
verses.textEn: From the descendants of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth and Elijah.

verses.textZh: 萨土的子孙中，有以利约乃、以利亚实、玛他尼、耶利末、撒拔和亚西撒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 萨土的子孙中，有以利约乃、以利亚实、玛他尼、耶利末、撒拔和亚西撒。
verses.textZhCuv: 萨土的子孙中，有以利约乃、以利亚实、玛他尼、耶利末、撒拔、亚西撒。
verses.textEnNiv: From the descendants of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad and Aziza.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza;
verses.textEnNlt: From the family of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.
verses.textEnNasb: and of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza;
verses.textEn: From the descendants of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad and Aziza.

verses.textZh: 比拜的子孙中，有约哈难、哈拿尼雅、萨拜和亚勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比拜的子孙中，有约哈难、哈拿尼雅、萨拜和亚勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 比拜的子孙中，有约哈难、哈拿尼雅、萨拜、亚勒。
verses.textEnNiv: From the descendants of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai and Athlai.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the sons of Bebai were Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
verses.textEnNkjv: of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai;
